items.article: A Deflated Football is collected by Raiders to fulfill certain objectives. These items are typically found scattered across the Buried City map, often located near kiosk areas. They are gathered as part of The League quest, which may also require a tool for inflation.

items.name: Degraded ARC Rubber
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: Degraded ARC Rubber is a common material used to gain resources when recycled. It was once a whole ARC Flex Rubber that has since broken down. Raiders obtain this item by looting arcs, specifically by scavenging remains of creatures like the Baron Husk.

items.name: Deprecated Anvil Splitter
items.description: No longer functional, but can still be sold or recycled.

stat_block.compatibleWeapons: Anvil

items.article: The Anvil Splitter is a weapon modification designed for the Anvil gun. Its primary role is to change how it fires, making each shot split into four separate projectiles instead of one. While each of these individual split projectiles deals less damage, this mod significantly increases the overall number of projectiles released with every shot. This item can be obtained through scavenging, typically found while exploring different areas.

items.name: Desk Lamp
items.description: May be worth a few coins.

items.name: Differential Microphone
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.

items.name: Diving Goggles
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: Diving Goggles are items that Raiders can collect and then recycle. Recycling them provides general resources, which are useful for various needs. These goggles are primarily found inside containers located within the Buried City map. They are also often discovered by Raiders during the Night Raid event.

items.name: Dockmaster's Detector
items.description: These detectors seem to be able to locate foreign objects buried in the sands around Riven Tides, though their exact way of functioning is unknown.
items.article: The Dockmaster's Detector is a gadget that helps Raiders find buried objects in the sand. It is used specifically during the Beachcombing map condition on the Riven Tides map. When active, it provides sound cues and visual signals to show how close you are to a hidden item. Using the detector slows your movement speed and consumes its energy, which recharges gradually when not in use. Even if you carry multiple detectors, they all share the same energy meter, so carrying more won't give you longer usage time. You can find this item by searching during the Beachcombing map condition on the Riven Tides map.

items.name: Dodger's Note
items.description: A hurriedly scribbled note, all crumpled up.

items.name: Dog Collar
items.description: After all this time, you can still smell the goodness.
items.article: The Dog Collar is used to help improve your companion, Scrappy. Its primary purpose is to upgrade Scrappy from its first level to its second level, making it more capable as you progress.

items.name: Dolabra
items.description: An experimental weapon that can either fire a wide short range blast, or be focused to fire a tight medium range beam of heat.
items.article:
The Dolabra is a semi-automatic shotgun that uses energy clips to fire energy beams. It can switch between two firing modes: a wide, short-range blast when hip-firing, or a focused, medium-range beam when aiming down sights. This weapon cannot be upgraded.

To obtain the Dolabra, you must first acquire its Dolabra Blueprint, which is found inside the ARC Assessor. Once you have learned the blueprint, you can craft it at a Gunsmith.

items.name: Dolabra Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Dolabra Shotgun.
items.article: The Dolabra Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Dolabra at a Gunsmith bench. This blueprint is found by looting ARC Assessor.

items.name: Doodly Duck
items.description: Everything is a canvas to a creative child.
items.flavor_text: Can be thrown to create noise.
items.article: The Doodly Duck is a Rare Trinket that is a variant of the Rubber Duck. Raiders can throw this item to create noise, which can be used as a distraction. It can also be collected in the stash to decorate the Raider Den. Other variants include the Alien Duck, Familiar Duck, Flashy Duck, Gentle Duck, and Tropical Duck. This duck is found inside chimneys while Bird City is active.

items.name: Door Blocker
items.description: A locking mechanism that can be placed on large metal doors to limit access.
items.article:
The Door Blocker is a common utility item that Raiders can place on button-operated doors to prevent them from being opened. Once positioned, it cannot be recovered or removed without breaching the door. This item is helpful for controlling access to areas or securing routes.

Raiders can obtain this item through several methods:

  • By scavenging in the environment.
  • By crafting it at Utility Station.
  • By purchasing it from Apollo for 810 coins, with a daily limit of 6.
  • As a reward from the Raider Deck AR/RD 001: Ryder & Voyager, specifically from the "PROTECTION PACK" found on Page 3.

items.name: Dried-Out ARC Resin
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: Dried-Out ARC Resin is a resource that can be recycled for crafting materials. It used to be an intact ARC Synthetic Resin but is now in a damaged state. You can obtain this item by scavenging the husks of defeated ARCs, particularly the Baron Husk.

items.name: Duct Tape
items.description: Used to craft a wide range of items. Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: Duct Tape is a crafting material primarily used to craft weapon modifications. You can find it by scavenging in the environment. It is also obtained by recycling salvage. Additionally, Celeste sells this item for coins.

items.name: Durable Cloth
items.description: Used to craft medical supplies.
items.article:
Durable Cloth is a refined material used to craft medical supplies. It helps you progress by letting you create various items. It is also needed for upgrading the Medical Lab and completing Expedition projects.

You can find Durable Cloth by scavenging in medical and commercial areas, often inside containers such as Industrial Drawers and Blue Multi Drawers. Additionally, it can be crafted at a Refiner using salvage materials. You can also obtain it by recycling salvage or by salvaging other items.

items.name: Dusty Film Reel
items.description: A dusty recording of a solemn corporate announcement.

items.name: Electrical Components
items.description: Used to craft a wide range of items. Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.flavor_text: Used to craft: Tactical Mk.2, Combat Mk.2, Looting Mk.2, Advanced Electrical Components, Surge Shield Recharger
items.article:
Electrical Components are refined materials used for crafting items like Jolt Mines and Surge Shield Rechargers. They are also needed to upgrade your Gear Bench and Utility Station, and for Expedition projects.

You can find these components by defeating ARCs such as the Rocketeer, Vaporizer, Android, and Arc Courier. They are often looted from containers like Breachable Containers, Bags, and Cars. Exploration in the Blue Gate, Stella Montis, Spaceport, Buried City, and Dam Battlegrounds maps can also yield them, particularly during events like Night Raid and Harvester. You can also craft them at a Refiner or recycle them for resources.

items.name: Electrician (Backpack)
items.description: Black

items.name: Elephant Obelisk
items.description: An object of particular nomadic fixation, some believe that these legendary beasts of burden carried the Launch Towers into place.

items.name: Embedded Blast Engineering
items.description: Armor does a good job against bullets. Small explosions are less respectful of the arrangement. Combining the two might be worth exploring.

items.name: Emperor Beacon
items.description: A beacon with a copy of the Emperor's identifier signal. Deploy in an open area to call in Harvester Payloads.

items.name: Emperor Gateway Conduit
items.description: Combining three distinct couplers, this conduit seems to fit into the Fallen Emperor at Pendola Pass.

items.name: Emperor Gateway Conduit Blueprint
items.description: CollectorKey Blueprint Description

items.name: Emperor Modulator
items.description: Can be used to upgrade the Gunsmith.

items.name: Empty Wine Bottle
items.description: Yes, it really is empty.
items.article: The Empty Wine Bottle is used in crafting. Its main purpose is to be combined with other materials to create a beverage, a process that requires the In-Round Crafting skill. Raiders can obtain empty wine bottles by salvaging salvage, or by finding them as loot in Residential and Commercial areas.

items.name: Energy Clip
items.description: Ammo used for energy weapons. One clip will fully charge a single weapon.
items.article:
Energy Clips are a type of ammunition used for recharging energy weapons like the Jupiter, Equalizer, and Dolabra. One clip fully recharges a single weapon. This ammunition is effective at penetrating ARC armor, performing at least as well as Heavy Ammo.

You can get Energy Clips in several ways:

  • They are salvaged from defeated ARCs.
  • You can find them by scavenging in the environment.
  • They can be crafted at a Workbench.
  • They are sold by the vendor Tian Wen.

items.name: Epoxy Bucket
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.

items.name: Equalizer
items.description: A high capacity experimental beam rifle.
items.flavor_text: Extremely effective against ARC armor plating and limbs
items.article: The Equalizer is a fully-automatic Special Beam Rifle that fires energy-based projectiles. Raiders can craft this weapon at the Gunsmith after learning the Equalizer Blueprint.

items.name: Equalizer Blueprint
items.description: A high capacity experimental beam rifle.
items.article: The Equalizer Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Equalizer at Gunsmith. This fully-automatic special beam rifle fires energy-based projectiles. You can obtain it by finding it inside the Harvester.

items.name: Equatorial Sundial
items.description: A marvel of ancient ingenuity, those with a penchant for stargazing may find the mesmerizing patterns oddly familiar.

items.name: Espresso Machine Parts
items.description: Replacement parts salvaged from an espresso machine.

items.name: ESR Analyzer
items.description: A portable analyzer from the world before, complete with several spare tubes.
items.article: The ESR Analyzer is a specialized medical device required for Lance's A Reveal in Ruins quest. You can find this item by searching pharmacies located within the Buried City map. Placing the item in your safe pocket will prevent it from being lost if you are defeated.

items.name: Exodus Modules
items.description: Used to craft a wide range of items.
items.flavor_text: Used to craft: Tempest, Vulcano, Hullcracker, Bobcat, Snap Hook
items.article: Exodus Modules are essential for crafting advanced weapons and tools. They are also used to repair equipment and progress various Expedition and Trophy Display projects. You can obtain these modules by scavenging, finding them in Red Lockers, or purchasing them from Celeste, who offers one per day.

items.name: Exodus Technical Handbook
items.description: Filled with equal parts obscure jargon and complex diagrams.

items.name: Experimental Seed Sample
items.description: A cryogenically frozen research sample of an experimental crop.

items.name: Expired Pasta
items.description: Way pasta its prime.
items.article: Expired Pasta is a food item used to restore a Raider's health. It helps you recover during raids.

items.name: Expired Respirator
items.description: The filters are clogged with sand and noxious fumes. Long past its lifespan.

items.name: Expired Security Code
items.description: An expired security code. Has no more practical use.

items.name: Explosive Compound
items.description: Used to craft explosives.
items.article: Explosive Compound is a refined material used to create various types of explosives. Raiders can obtain it by looting arcs, such as the Comet, or by searching in industrial and security areas and opening metal crates. It can also be crafted at a Refiner using other materials. This item is a key component for crafting explosives at an Explosives Station level 1. Additionally, it can be recycled into other materials or salvaged from other items.

items.name: Explosive Mine
items.description: A proximity-triggered mine that pops up and explodes, dealing damage to anything within its radius.
items.article: The Explosive Mine is a device that triggers and explodes when ARCs enter its range, dealing damage to targets in that area. Raiders can craft this item at an Explosives Station level 1 after learning the Explosive Mine Blueprint. This item can also be recycled for resources or salvaged for materials.

items.name: Explosive Mine Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft an Explosive Mine
items.article: The Explosive Mine Blueprint is a blueprint that lets you craft Explosive Mines at an Explosives Station. An Explosive Mine is a device that detonates when enemies enter its detection radius, releasing a blast that damages targets in the vicinity.

items.name: Extended Barrel I
items.description: Slightly increases bullet velocity & distance until damage falloff.

stat_block.compatibleWeapons: Tempest, Arpeggio, Bettina, Anvil, Torrente

items.article: The Extended Barrel I is a weapon attachment. Attachments like this can be used to influence various aspects of a weapon's performance.

items.name: Extended Barrel II
items.description: Moderately increases bullet velocity & distance until damage falloff.

stat_block.compatibleWeapons: Tempest, Arpeggio, Bettina, Anvil, Torrente

items.article: Extended Barrel II is a blueprint component mentioned in overviews discussing new blueprints. It is part of a series of similar items, alongside Extended Barrel I and Extended Barrel III.

items.name: Extended Barrel II Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft an Extended Barrel II
items.article: The Extended Barrel II Blueprint is a blueprint that, once acquired, permanently unlocks your ability to craft the Extended Barrel II at a crafting station in your Hideout whenever you have the required materials.

items.name: Extended Barrel III
items.description: Significantly increases bullet velocity & distance until damage falloff.

stat_block.compatibleWeapons: Ferro, Kettle, Rattler, Stitcher, Anvil, Arpeggio, Burletta, Osprey, Renegade, Torrente, Bettina, Bobcat, Tempest

items.article: The Extended Barrel IIII is a modification for weapons, designed to be attached to a firearm's barrel. It is part of a range of barrel modifications, alongside items such as the Extended Barrel I, Extended Barrel II, and Extended Barrel III.

items.name: Extended Barrel III Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft an Extended Barrel III
items.article: The Extended Barrel III Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft an extended barrel attachment at the Workbench. It improves how fast bullets travel from your weapons.

items.name: Extended Burst Cycles
items.description: A burst has a beginning, a middle, and an end. The middle could probably use more bullets. Let's investigate.

items.name: Extended Light Mag I
items.description: Slightly extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use light ammo.
items.article:
Extended Light Mag I is a Weapon Mod that makes compatible weapons hold slightly more ammunition. It adds 5 to the magazine size of compatible weapons.

You can find this mod by scavenging, or craft it at a Gunsmith bench level 1. It is also sold by the vendor Tian Wen for 1,920 coins, with a limit of 5 per day.

items.name: Extended Light Mag II
items.description: Moderately extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use light ammo.

stat_block.compatibleWeapons: Kettle, Burletta, Hairpin, Stitcher, Bobcat

items.article: The Extended Light Mag II is a weapon modification that increases the amount of ammunition a compatible weapon can hold. It adds 10 rounds to a weapon's magazine capacity. To craft this modification, you need the Extended Light Mag II Blueprint and access to a crafting station. This item can also be recycled to recover some resources.

items.name: Extended Light Mag II Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Extended Light Mag II
items.article: The Extended Light Mag II Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Extended Light Mag II weapon mod at a Gunsmith Bench, which helps by increasing the ammo capacity of compatible weapons. Blueprints for gun parts, such as this one, are typically found when scavenging Raider Containers, which can appear in any map. They may also be obtained as a reward from Trials. Once you use a blueprint, it is consumed and the recipe becomes permanently available for crafting. If you find a blueprint you already know, it can be sold for 5,000 coins.

items.name: Extended Light Mag III
items.description: Significantly extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use light ammo.
items.article:
The Extended Light Mag III is a weapon modification that increases the ammunition capacity of compatible weapons.

You can craft the Extended Light Mag III at a Gunsmith Bench level 1 after acquiring the Extended Light Mag III Blueprint.

items.name: Extended Light Mag III Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Extended Light Mag III
items.article: The Extended Light Mag III Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Extended Light Mag III modification at a Gunsmith Bench level 1. This weapon mod significantly increases the ammunition capacity of compatible weapons.

items.name: Extended Medium Mag I
items.description: Slightly extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use medium ammo.
items.article: Extended Medium Mag I is a weapon modification. It helps by increasing the ammunition capacity for weapons that use medium ammo.

items.name: Extended Medium Mag II
items.description: Moderately extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use medium ammo.

stat_block.compatibleWeapons: Arpeggio, Osprey, Renegade, Torrente, Tempest, Venator

items.article:
The Extended Medium Mag II is a weapon modification that moderately increases the amount of ammo your compatible weapons can hold. This allows you to fire more shots before needing to reload.

You can obtain this mod by scavenging in the world. It can also be crafted at a Gunsmith station using the Extended Medium Mag II Blueprint and various other materials. Additionally, the vendor Shani sells this mod for 100 coins, with a daily limit of two per Raider. If you no longer need it, this mod can be recycled into other resources.

items.name: Extended Medium Mag II Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Extended Medium Mag II
items.article: The Extended Medium Mag II Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to create the Extended Medium Mag II at a crafting station with a Gunsmith skill level of 2. This weapon attachment increases the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use medium ammo, letting you fire more shots before needing to reload. You can purchase this blueprint from the vendor Shani for 100 coins, with a daily limit of two. It can also be found through scavenging.

items.name: Extended Medium Mag III
items.description: Significantly extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use medium ammo.
items.article: The Extended Medium Mag III is a weapon mod. Its main purpose is to increase the amount of ammunition a compatible weapon can hold, allowing for more shots before reloading. This mod is crafted at Gunsmith Bench level 1 using the Extended Medium Mag III Blueprint. If you have extra units of this mod, you can recycle or salvage it to recover various other resources.

items.name: Extended Medium Mag III Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft the Medium Mag III
items.article:
This is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Extended Medium Mag III weapon mod at a Gunsmith bench. Once crafted, it helps your compatible weapons hold a significantly larger amount of ammunition.

For a better chance to find the Extended Medium Mag III Blueprint, focus on Night Raids or Electromagnetic Storms, and target high-value loot zones or Residential-style containers, including suitcases on Spaceport and cupboards on Buried City Night Raid.

items.name: Extended Shotgun Mag I
items.description: Slightly extends the ammo capacity of shotguns.
items.article: The Extended Shotgun Mag I is a weapon modification designed to slightly extend the ammo capacity of compatible shotguns. Equipping this mod allows Raiders to carry more ammunition in their weapon, reducing the frequency of reloads during combat encounters.

items.name: Extended Shotgun Mag II
items.description: Moderately extends the ammo capacity of shotguns.
items.article: The Extended Shotgun Mag II is a weapon modification that increases the amount of ammunition a compatible weapon can hold. This helps you carry more ammunition into raids before needing to reload or resupply. You can craft this item at a Gunsmith station once you have its blueprint, using various resources. It can also be recycled for resources.

items.name: Extended Shotgun Mag II Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Extended Shotgun Mag II - Moderately extends the ammo capacity of shotguns.
items.article: The Extended Shotgun Mag II Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Extended Shotgun Mag II weapon mod at a Gunsmith bench level 1. This mod moderately increases the ammo capacity of shotguns. Blueprints can be obtained through scavenging, by completing Weekly Trials or projects, or as rewards from Quests. Certain ARCs can also drop blueprints. Unwanted blueprints can be sold for 5,000 coins.

items.name: Extended Shotgun Mag III
items.description: Significantly extends the ammo capacity of shotguns.
items.flavor_text: Compatible with: Il Toro, Vulcano
items.article: The Extended Shotgun Mag III is a weapon modification that extends the ammo capacity of shotguns by 6 rounds. It is compatible with weapons like the Il Toro and Vulcano. You can craft this modification at a Gunsmith bench level 3 or higher once you have the Extended Shotgun Mag III Blueprint and the necessary materials.

items.name: Extended Shotgun Mag III Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Extended Shotgun Mag III
items.article: The Extended Shotgun Mag III Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Extended Shotgun Mag III at the Gunsmith. This weapon modification for shotguns significantly increases ammunition capacity.

items.name: Fabric
items.description: Used to craft medical supplies and shields.

items.name: Faded Flush (Aviator Color)
items.description: A new cosmetic variant will be added to your collection.
items.article: The Faded Flush (Aviator Color) is a cosmetic option that lets you change the color scheme of your character's Aviator appearance. This allows you to personalize how your character looks in the game.

items.name: Faded Photograph
items.description: A snapshot of the world before, faded by sunlight and time.
items.article: The Faded Photograph is a collectible trinket that displays an old image, worn by time and sunlight. This item serves as a resource and may be needed for certain quests. Raiders obtain it by scavenging within Residential areas of the Buried City map.

items.name: Familiar Duck
items.description: Unlike the real one, this one fits in your pack.
items.flavor_text: Can be thrown to create noise.
items.article: The Familiar Duck is an Epic Trinket that can be thrown to create noise, which is useful for distracting ARCs. It can also be placed in your stash to decorate the Raider Den. This item is a variant of the Rubber Duck; other variants include the Alien Duck, Doodly Duck, Flashy Duck, Gentle Duck, and Tropical Duck. Raiders can find this item by scavenging inside chimneys when Bird City is active.

items.name: Fancy Plate
items.description: Careful not to shatter it.

items.name: Ferro I
items.description: Packs a punch, but must be reloaded between every shot.
items.flavor_text: Very effective against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Ferro I is a break-action Battle Rifle that uses Heavy Ammo. It offers an effective option for engaging targets from medium to long distances, though its necessary reload between shots means it can be less ideal for very close fights. It's often provided as part of the kit for Raiders choosing a Free Loadout.

You can find the Ferro I by scavenging in various areas, purchase it from Tian Wen, or craft it at a Workbench once you have the Gunsmith 1 skill. This weapon can also be upgraded into more advanced versions, and it can be recycled for useful resources.

items.name: Ferro II
items.description: Packs a punch, but must be reloaded between every shot.
items.flavor_text: Very effective against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Ferro II is an improved version of the Ferro I, a break-action battle rifle that uses heavy ammo. This weapon is useful for fighting ARCs from medium to long distances, particularly due to its effectiveness against ARC armor. Compared to the base Ferro I, the Ferro II reloads 13% faster and has increased durability.

You can craft the Ferro II at a Gunsmith workbench in your Hideout by upgrading an existing Ferro I. It can also be purchased from Tian Wen. Sometimes, Raiders who choose a Free Loadout may receive this weapon as part of their starting gear. Once acquired, it can be further upgraded into Ferro III or recycled into other resources.

items.name: Ferro III
items.description: Packs a punch, but must be reloaded between every shot.
items.flavor_text: Very effective against ARC armor plating
items.article: The Ferro III is an upgraded version of the Ferro break-action Battle Rifle, which is effective for engaging enemies at medium to long distances. It uses Heavy Ammo. This specific version features a 26% reduced reload time and 20 additional durability points, providing practical improvements during combat. You can craft it at a Gunsmith bench using other materials. It can also be recycled for resources.

items.name: Ferro IV
items.description: Packs a punch, but must be reloaded between every shot.
items.flavor_text: Very effective against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Ferro IV is an upgraded Battle Rifle that uses Heavy Ammo. It is designed for medium-to-long range combat and offers improved durability and significantly faster reloading compared to earlier versions of the weapon.

It is crafted by upgrading a Ferro III at a Workbench. This weapon can be repaired to restore its durability, recycled or salvaged for resources, and sold to vendors for coins.

items.name: Fertilizer
items.description: May be worth a few coins.
items.article: Fertilizer is a material used to help plants grow, often described as special dirt. It is needed to complete projects like Avian Alarm and is required for the Unexpected Initiative quest, where it must be delivered alongside a Water Pump. You can obtain it by scavenging from garden beds and wicker baskets. It also appears in greenhouses found in the Village on the Blue Gate map, and in hydroponic domes located on the Dam Battlegrounds map. This material can be recycled into other resources and can be sold for coins.

items.name: Film Reel
items.description: May be worth a few coins.
items.article:
A Film Reel is a collectible item that can be sold for coins.

You can find this item inside residential loot containers such as drawers and cabinets. Look for it in the Pale Apartments and Ruby Residence areas of the Dam Battlegrounds map. It also appears in Plaza Rosa and Grandioso Apartments in the Buried City map, and the Village in the Blue Gate map.

items.name: Fine Wristwatch
items.description: Perfect for telling the time, and showcasing that you're an exceedingly dignified person.
items.article: The Fine Wristwatch is a decorative item from an older time that has a base value of 3000 coins. This item can be found by scavenging containers such as lockers. It appears in the Buried City map, the Dam Battlegrounds map, the Blue Gate map, and the Stella Montis map, particularly within commercial and residential areas. It is also obtainable during the Night Raid event.

items.name: Finger Gun Single Shot (Emote)
items.description: A new cosmetic will be added to your collection
items.article: The Finger Gun Single Shot (Emote) is a way for your character to express themselves by performing a hand gesture that looks like shooting a gun. Raiders use this action for non-verbal communication and personal expression during gameplay. You can select this emote from your character's emote wheel.

items.name: Fireball Burner
items.description: Can be recycled into ARC Alloy.

guide_links.label: Destroy Ticks, Fireballs and Pops: Weekly Trials

items.article: The Fireball Burner is a throwable item that creates a small fire when it hits something. This fire damages nearby Fireballs and Raiders within its area. After it's used, you can pick up a Damaged Fireball Burner from where it landed. This item is important for upgrading your Refiner and is also required to complete the What Goes Around quest. You can also use it to craft other items or recycle it for useful resources. It is obtained by scavenging destroyed ARCs, specifically by defeating Fireballs and Couriers.

items.name: Firecracker
items.description: A device that sparks and pops in a pleasant manner.
items.article: The Firecracker is a common throwable item that creates a pleasant effect when used. Raiders can obtain this item by scavenging, crafting it at a Utility Station using collected resources, or purchasing it from the vendor Shani. If no longer needed, it can be recycled into various materials.

items.name: Firefly Burner
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.flavor_text: A volatile cansiter that vents fire when shot.
items.article: The Firefly Burner is a volatile canister that can be thrown and shot to vent fire and explode. This item is obtained by defeating Fireflies. Beyond its direct use, it is used to craft various items and is also needed to complete certain projects. It can also be recycled or salvaged to obtain crafting materials.

items.name: Fireworks Box
items.description: A remotely triggered arrangement of dazzling fireworks, sure to put on a show.
items.article: The Fireworks Box is a utility item that launches a dazzling display of fireworks when deployed and remotely triggered. You can craft this item at an Explosives Station after learning the Fireworks Box Blueprint, which is rewarded upon completing the Test Case quest or can be found during the "Cold Snap" map condition. You can also purchase it from Shani for 60 coins, with a daily limit of three. Additionally, three of these items can be obtained from Raider Deck AR/RD 002: Goalie, on Page 2.

items.name: Fireworks Box Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Fireworks Box
items.article: The Fireworks Box Blueprint is a blueprint that lets you craft a Fireworks Box. This blueprint can be found as a reward for completing certain quests. Additionally, it is often discovered in breachable containers and lockers during the Cold Snap event. Raiders have reported finding it in areas like the Water Treatment and Power Generation Complex within the Dam map, in hospital lockers on the Buried City map, and near extraction vents in the Blue Gate map. The blueprint has a value of 5000 coins.

items.name: First Wave Compass
items.description: Dusty but functional, these helped chart a course when when all seemed lost.

items.name: First Wave Rations
items.description: Often heated above discreet fires, these meager provisions are said to have fueled a resistance.

items.name: First Wave Tape
items.description: An old tape found inside a battered old camcorder.

items.name: Flame Spray
items.description: A classic makeshift weapon, sure to leave scorch marks.
items.article: The Flame Spray is an Uncommon Gadget that lets you spray fire at enemies. It is a weapon you craft during a raid, which requires a specific skill called In-Round Crafting. This item can also be obtained from certain Raider Decks, such as the 'IMPROVISATION PACK' found in Raider Deck AR/RD 001: Ryder & Voyager. To repair it, you will need salvage materials.

items.name: Flashy Duck
items.description: Lovingly hand-painted by someone of great talent—clearly. Any guesses who?
items.flavor_text: Can be thrown to create noise.
items.article: The Flashy Duck is a decorative trinket, which is a variant of the rubber duck. You can display it in your Raider Den stash for decoration or throw it during a raid to create noise and distract enemies. This item is found inside chimneys while the Bird City event is active. Other variants include the Alien Duck, Doodly Duck, Familiar Duck, Gentle Duck, and Tropical Duck.

items.name: Flow Controller
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Flow Controller is a rare item primarily used for recycling into crafting materials. It is also needed to complete the Snap And Salvage quest, which requires one Magnetron and one Flow Controller. You can find this item by scavenging in the Stella Montis map.

items.name: Flushing Terminal Key
items.description: A pungent key used to operate the Flushing Terminals in the tunnels below Spaceport.
items.article: The Flushing Terminal Key is a quest item used to progress The Stench of Corruption. Raiders use this key to activate a specific Flushing Terminal located in the underground tunnels of the Spaceport map. To obtain it, search a clothing rack in the Staff Locker Room within the Departure Building, also on the Spaceport map.

items.name: Fluted Rotor Core
items.description: Used to craft amplified weapons.

items.name: Food Wrapper
items.description: The vibrant colors and natural stickiness have made them a favorite among the more artistic Speranzans.

items.name: Fossilized Lightning
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: Fossilized Lightning is an Epic item that serves as a crafting resource. You can break it down to obtain other crafting materials. To find this item, you need to be aware of the Electromagnetic Storm map condition; it occasionally appears at the epicenter of lightning strikes during these events. This item is collected by scavenging it from the environment.

items.name: Free Loadout Augment
items.description: Basic augment for rookie Raiders, offering slightly more backpack space and carry capacity.
items.article: The Free Loadout Augment is a basic augment designed to increase a Raider's carrying capacity. It provides slightly more backpack space, allowing for a maximum of 35.0 weight, and is compatible with light shields. Raiders receive this augment at no cost when choosing to deploy with a Free Loadout. It can be exchanged with Lance for other basic augments, such as the Looting Mk. 1, Combat Mk. 1, or Tactical Mk. 1. Additionally, it can be recycled for resources or sold for coins.

items.name: Frequency Modulation Box
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Frequency Modulation Box is a rare item. It is needed for specific projects, such as Stage 4 of Expedition 2. You can also recycle it into various resources. These items are found by scavenging objects and containers within the Stella Montis map.

items.name: Fried Motherboard
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Fried Motherboard is primarily used to upgrade the Utility Station. You can also recycle it into general crafting materials. Look for Fried Motherboards by scavenging from containers such as Server Racks and Recording Panels.

items.name: Frigate Diagnostic Node
items.description: Found in the trail of ARC Frigates, the electromagnetic signatures of these nodes turn out to be partially decipherable.

items.name: Frigate Inductor
items.description: Can be used to upgrade the Research Station.

items.name: Frosty Duck
items.description: A dapper little fellow.

items.name: Fruit Mix
items.description: A food item that moderately increases both health and stamina.
items.article: The Fruit Mix is a food item that helps you recover. Eating it will increase your health by 25 and your stamina by 50. You can create this item using in-round crafting.

items.name: Frying Pan
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Frying Pan is a rare item you can find by searching through the environment, also known as scavenging. It serves a practical purpose as it can be recycled into crafting materials, helping you gather resources for other item projects. Raiders often discover Frying Pans in residential areas, particularly when the Flickering Flames Event is active.

items.name: Garlic Press
items.description: It'll press garlic, olives, and probably many other things.
items.article: The Garlic Press is primarily valued for the materials it provides. It is especially useful for recycling, where it yields salvage. Raiders can also choose to sell this item for coins, and it is known to fetch a higher value than some other common items.

items.name: Gas Grenade
items.description: A grenade that emits a lingering toxic cloud on impact, draining the stamina of any Raiders within its area of effect.
items.article: The Gas Grenade is a throwable item that creates a toxic cloud on impact. This cloud drains the stamina of any Raiders caught inside its area. It can be found through scavenging in the environment. Raiders can also craft it at an Explosives Station or purchase it from Apollo for coins. Additionally, it is used to craft other items at various stations. It can also be recycled for resources.

items.name: Gas Grenade Trap
items.description: A laser trip wire that detonates a Gas Grenade.
items.article: The Gas Grenade Trap is a device that projects a visible red laser. When something crosses this laser, it triggers a gas grenade, releasing a cloud of gas. This gas drains the stamina of anyone caught in its fumes. You can place this trap on most surfaces, but its laser is clearly visible. If it hasn't detonated, the Raider who placed it can disarm and recover it. It is crafted at Workbench.

items.name: Gas Mine
items.description: A proximity-triggered mine that pops up and deploys a gas cloud that rapidly drains stamina.
items.article: A Gas Mine is a deployable item that activates when ARCs enter its detection range. When triggered, it releases a cloud of gas that rapidly drains the stamina of Raiders caught within its radius and makes it harder for them to see. This effect lasts for a limited time, making it useful for controlling ARC movement or creating an escape route. You can craft it at an Explosives Station level 1, but you will first need to learn the Gas Mine Blueprint. Additionally, it can be bought directly from Apollo. If you have extra, they can be recycled to recover some basic resources.

items.name: Gas Mine Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Gas Mine
items.article: The Gas Mine Blueprint is a blueprint that unlocks the crafting recipe for the Gas Mine. Once you use this blueprint in Speranza, the recipe becomes permanently available, and the blueprint is consumed. With the recipe learned, you can then craft it at an Explosives Station level 1. It is a mine that is triggered when ARCs get near, releasing a cloud of gas that quickly drains their stamina and makes it difficult for them to see.

items.name: Geiger Counter
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Geiger Counter is a device you can recycle for crafting materials. It is also used in various projects. You can find this item by scavenging in the Stella Montis map.

items.name: Gentle Duck
items.description: Udderly adorable.
items.flavor_text: Can be thrown to create noise.
items.article: The Gentle Duck is a collectible item that you can place in your Hideout for decoration. It can also be thrown to create noise, which is useful for distracting ARCs. You can find this duck by scavenging inside chimneys when the Bird City event is active. As a variant of the Rubber Duck, it belongs to a collection that also includes the Alien Duck, Doodly Duck, Familiar Duck, Flashy Duck, and Tropical Duck.

items.name: Glitched ARC Circuitry
items.description: A hefty, electro-mechanical part with integrated magnetic circuitry. Perhaps used for data storage or processing.
items.flavor_text: 100 Merits upon return to Speranza.

items.name: Glitched ARC Light Ring
items.description: A circular light located on the undercarriage of the glitched Wasp.
items.flavor_text: 50 Merits upon return to Speranza.

items.name: Glitched ARC Phased Array
items.description: A part composed of hundreds of miniscule repeating metallic cells. It exhibits electrical integration and appears mechanically immobile.
items.flavor_text: 25 Merits upon return to Speranza.

items.name: Glitched ARC Power Converter
items.description: A compact, cylindrical part with multiple metallic layers. Its industrial architecture suggests a heavy-duty energy transformation function.
items.flavor_text: 10 Merits upon return to Speranza.

items.name: Glitched ARC Transmitter
items.description: A metallic part with a hollow center, like a socket or port waiting for a plug, with four antenna-like prongs at its corners.
items.flavor_text: 15 Merits upon return to Speranza.

items.name: Goggles (Radio Renegade Variant)
items.description: Radio Renegade cosmetic variant - unlocked by completing A Warm Place to Rest quest.
items.article: The Goggles (Radio Renegade Variant) are a cosmetic item used to change the appearance of your character's headgear. They are a distinctive part of the Radio Renegade outfit style, allowing Raiders to customize their look. To obtain them, you must successfully complete the A Warm Place to Rest quest.

items.name: Gothic Graffiti (Aviator Color)
items.description: A new cosmetic variant will be added to your collection.
items.article: The Gothic Graffiti (Aviator Color) is a cosmetic item that adds a new visual style to your collection, allowing you to customize your in-game appearance. Raiders can obtain this item through Twitch drops, which are special rewards provided during certain official ARC Raiders streams on Twitch.

items.name: Grappling Hook
items.description: A simple gadget that anchors to most surfaces, allowing users to navigate hard-to-reach places.

items.name: Grappling Hook Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Grappling Hook

items.name: Great Mullein
items.description: Used to craft medical supplies.
items.article: Great Mullein is a plant resource that can be collected in the game world. It is found as a natural spawn in various areas across the Buried City map. Raiders gather this item directly from the environment; it is not obtained by looting arcs or looting containers.

items.name: Green Light Stick
items.description: A throwable chemical light that illuminates the area around it.
items.flavor_text: Illumination Radius 7m
items.article: The Green Light Stick is a specific type of light stick. It is a distinct item often categorized alongside the Blue Light Stick.

items.name: Green Light Stick Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Green Light Stick.
items.article: The Green Light Stick Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft a Green Light Stick.

items.name: Hairpin I
items.description: Has a built-in silencer. Great for stealth, but tricky in combat.
items.flavor_text: Weak against ARC armor plating
items.article: The Hairpin I is a pistol that uses Light Ammo. It is a common rarity weapon, notable for its built-in silencer, which makes it effective for stealth. Raiders can obtain it through scavenging, by crafting it at Workbench, or by purchasing it from Tian Wen. This item serves as a base for crafting more advanced versions, such as Hairpin II, Hairpin III, and Hairpin IV. It can also be recycled for various resources.

items.name: Hairpin II
items.description: Has a built-in silencer. Great for stealth, but tricky in combat.
items.flavor_text: Weak against ARC armor plating
items.article: The Hairpin II is an upgraded pistol that uses light ammo and features a built-in silencer. This improved model offers a 10% increased fire rate, 13% reduced reload time, and increased durability. It can be crafted at a Gunsmith bench. It can also be recycled for resources or have its durability restored.

items.name: Hairpin III
items.description: Has a built-in silencer. Great for stealth, but tricky in combat.
items.flavor_text: Weak against ARC armor plating
items.article: The Hairpin III is an upgraded slide-action pistol that uses light ammo and features a built-in silencer. Compared to earlier versions, it provides an increased fire rate, faster reloading, and improved durability. You can craft this pistol at the Gunsmith using various components. It can also be repaired using various materials or recycled to recover resources.

items.name: Hairpin IV
items.description: Has a built-in silencer. Great for stealth, but tricky in combat.
items.flavor_text: Weak against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Hairpin IV is an upgraded slide-action Pistol that uses Light Ammo. It comes with a built-in silencer, making it suitable for stealth during encounters. Upgrading to Hairpin IV increases its fire rate, reduces its reload time, and boosts its durability compared to previous versions.

You can craft the Hairpin IV by upgrading a Hairpin III at a Gunsmith, using various other materials. It can also be recycled or salvaged to recover some resources. When sold, it fetches 2,900 coins.

items.name: Hand Drill
items.description: Used in crafting.

items.name: Happy Jig (Emote)
items.description: Maintain at least a  Rookie II rank in trials until season end.
items.article: The Happy Jig is an emote that allows your character to perform a specific dance in the game. It is a cosmetic item used for self-expression. Raiders can obtain this emote by achieving at least a Rookie II rank in trials and keeping that rank until the end of the season.

items.name: Harmonica
items.description: A playable harmonica used to attract ARC's attention, and impress other Raiders.

items.name: Headphones
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: Headphones are a rare item Raiders can find in the game. Their primary purpose is to be recycled, providing Raiders with useful crafting materials and components. Raiders typically obtain them by scavenging in residential and commercial areas.

items.name: Heavy Ammo
items.description: Heavy bullets used mainly with large-caliber weapons.
items.article:
Heavy Ammo is a type of ammunition for high-caliber weapons. It helps you take down ARCs more effectively because it can penetrate their armor better than Medium Ammo and Light Ammo, though it is not as strong as Launcher Ammo.

You can find Heavy Ammo by scavenging, or it might drop from defeated ARCs such as the Rocketeer, Rocketeer Husk, and Sentinel. It can also be found in Raider Caches or purchased from the vendor Tian Wen. You can craft it at a Workbench.

items.name: Heavy Fuze Grenade
items.description: A grenade that detonates after a delay, dealing explosive damage in its radius.
items.article: The Heavy Fuze Grenade is an explosive device that detonates after a short delay, creating a large blast that damages ARCs in its area. Raiders can find this grenade by scavenging in the environment or craft it at an Explosives Station level 3.

items.name: Heavy Gun Parts
items.description: Used to craft weapons.
items.article: Heavy Gun Parts are a material used to upgrade, craft, and repair weapons. Raiders can find them by searching in Security and Raider areas, or by salvaging them from defeated Bombardiers and Rocketeers. Additionally, they can be crafted at a Refiner after learning a blueprint. They can also be purchased from Celeste.

items.name: Heavy Gun Parts Blueprint
items.description: Used directly in crafting items of all tiers.
items.article: The Heavy Gun Parts Blueprint is a schematic that teaches you how to craft Heavy Gun Parts at a Refiner. This process requires crafting materials as ingredients. They are then used to upgrade, craft, and repair various weapons, and are also a component in creating other items at a Gunsmith.

items.name: Heavy Shield
items.description: A heavy shield that blocks a large portion of incoming damage, but carries a significant cost to mobility.
items.article: The Heavy Shield is an equipable item that blocks a large portion of incoming damage, though it reduces your character's movement speed. To use this shield, Raiders must have specific augmentations equipped, including Combat Mk. 2, Combat Mk. 3 (Aggressive), Looting Mk. 3 (Safekeeper), or Tactical Mk. 3 (Defensive). It can be crafted at a Gear Bench, found through scavenging, or purchased from Lance with coins. This item can be repaired with resources or recycled into other materials.

items.name: Helmet (Radio Renegade Variant)
items.description: Radio Renegade Helmet Variant - Unlocks by completing Flickering Threat Quest
items.article: The Helmet (Radio Renegade Variant) is a cosmetic item that Raiders can equip to customize the appearance of their character. This specific helmet style is part of the Radio Renegade outfit.

items.name: Herbal Bandage
items.description: An improvised medical item that gradually restores health over time.
items.article: The Herbal Bandage is an improvised medical item that slowly restores your health over time. When used, it heals you for 3.5 health per second over 10 seconds. You can craft this item at a Medical Lab using salvage materials. Alternatively, it can be crafted if you have the Traveling Tinkerer skill. It can also be obtained from certain in-game decks.

items.name: Hidden Bunker Key
items.description: A makeshift key that lets you open a bunker in Spaceport

items.name: High-Voltage Exposure
items.description: Some ARC machines appear capable of absorbing energy before putting it back to use. The same principle might be worth testing on something a little less insulated.

items.name: Horizontal Grip
items.description: Moderately reduces both vertical recoil and horizontal recoil.

stat_block.compatibleWeapons: Rattler, Kettle, Ferro, Hullcracker, Venator

items.flavor_text: 30% Reduced Horizontal Recoil - 30% Reduced ADS Speed
items.article: The Horizontal Grip is a weapon modification that helps improve stability when firing. When attached to a compatible weapon, it reduces both vertical recoil and horizontal recoil by 30%. This grip also causes a 30% reduction in the speed at which Raiders can aim down sights. This modification can be broken down into various components and resources through recycling.

items.name: Hornet Driver
items.description: Can be recycled into ARC Alloy.
items.article:
The Hornet Driver is a thrown item that temporarily stuns nearby Hornets for seven seconds and other Raiders for half a second within a six-meter range. It is obtained by scavenging destroyed Hornets. Once thrown, a Damaged Hornet Driver can be retrieved from where it landed.

This item is used to craft tools. It is also required to upgrade the Gear Bench and progress through the The Trifecta quest. Additionally, it contributes to the Trophy Display project.

items.name: Household Cleaner
items.description: Can be recycled into chemicals.
items.article: The Household Cleaner is an uncommon item that serves as a valuable source of crafting materials. You can recycle this item to break it down into various resources, which are important for your crafting and upgrade efforts. To obtain it, search containers and explore residential areas.

items.name: Hullcracker Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft an Hullcracker
items.article: The Hullcracker Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Hullcracker I at the Gunsmith. You can obtain this blueprint as a reward upon completing the quest called "The Major's Footlocker". For an overview of available tasks, visit the Quests page.

items.name: Hullcracker I
items.description: Fires explosive projectiles that only detonate when hitting ARC.
items.article:
The Hullcracker I is a pump-action Grenade Launcher that fires explosive projectiles. These projectiles only detonate when they hit an ARC, making it effective for targeting enemy armor. It uses launcher ammo.

You can craft Hullcracker I at a Gunsmith bench level 1 once you have learned the Hullcracker Blueprint. It can also be found through scavenging or bought from the vendor Tian Wen for coins.

Hullcracker I can be used as a base to craft upgraded versions, such as Hullcracker II, Hullcracker III, and Hullcracker IV. It can also be recycled for resources or salvaged for materials.

items.name: Hullcracker II
items.description: Fires explosive projectiles that only detonate when hitting ARC.
items.article:
Hullcracker II is an upgraded version of the Hullcracker I, a special pump-action Grenade Launcher. This weapon fires explosive projectiles that only detonate upon hitting an ARC, making it effective for breaking through enemy defenses. It offers an 18% increased fire rate and +10 durability compared to its predecessor.

You can craft this weapon at a Gunsmith bench using a Hullcracker I and other crafting materials. The blueprint for the initial Hullcracker is rewarded from the quest The Major's Footlocker.

It can be further upgraded at a Gunsmith bench into more powerful versions, or recycled for materials.

items.name: Hullcracker III
items.description: Fires explosive projectiles that only detonate when hitting ARC.
items.article:
The Hullcracker III is an upgraded version of the Hullcracker, a special pump-action launcher that uses launcher ammo. It fires explosive projectiles designed to detonate only when hitting ARCs. Its strong armor penetration helps reveal ARC weak spots.

This specific model has a higher fire rate and increased durability compared to earlier versions.

Raiders craft the Hullcracker III by upgrading the Hullcracker II at the Gunsmith.

items.name: Hullcracker IV
items.description: Fires explosive projectiles that only detonate when hitting ARC.
items.article:
The Hullcracker IV is an upgraded pump-action grenade launcher that fires special explosive projectiles. These projectiles are designed to only detonate when they hit an ARC, making the weapon effective for breaking through their defenses. It uses launcher ammo.

This weapon is obtained by crafting a Hullcracker III at a Gunsmith crafting station.

items.name: Humidifier
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: A Humidifier is a crafting material and can also be recycled into other resources. Raiders need Humidifiers to progress through certain projects, such as stage 4 of the Expedition 1 project. You can obtain Humidifiers by scavenging within the Buried City, with a guaranteed appearance in the Red Tower lockers.

items.name: Husk Lily
items.description: These beautiful, but toxic flowers only grow around Baron husks. As for why, your guess is as good as anyone's.

items.name: Ice Cream Scooper
items.description: It is theorized that scooping things was a favorite pastime in the world before.
items.article: The Ice Cream Scooper is a component that can be recycled for resources or sold for coins.

items.name: Il Toro Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft an Il Toro
items.article: The Il Toro Blueprint is a blueprint that allows Raiders to create the Il Toro shotgun at a Gunsmith bench. It is known for its high damage output at close distances.

items.name: Il Toro I
items.description: Has a large bullet spread, sharp falloff, and high damage output.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Il Toro I is a pump-action shotgun that uses Shotgun Ammo. It is effective for dealing high damage to enemies at close range.

You can find the Il Toro I by scavenging, or purchase it from Tian Wen. It can also be crafted at a Workbench or Gunsmith, facilities often found in your Hideout, once you have learned the Il Toro Blueprint and gathered the necessary materials.

This shotgun can be upgraded into the Il Toro II, Il Toro III, and Il Toro IV at a Gunsmith using crafting materials. To repair it, you will need crafting materials. You can also recycle it for general resources or salvage it for other materials. It can be sold for coins.

items.name: Il Toro II
items.description: Has a large bullet spread, sharp falloff, and high damage output.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article: The Il Toro II is an upgraded version of the Il Toro I shotgun, designed for close-range combat. It deals high damage using ammunition. This upgraded model improves upon the base shotgun by offering an increased fire rate, a larger magazine capacity, and better durability. Raiders can craft it at a Gunsmith Bench level 1. It can also be recycled to recover useful components.

items.name: Il Toro III
items.description: Has a large bullet spread, sharp falloff, and high damage output.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article: Il Toro III is an upgraded version of the Il Toro II shotgun, designed for close-range combat. Raiders can craft it at a Gunsmith by upgrading an Il Toro II with salvage materials. Compared to previous versions, it features a 35% increased fire rate, adds two rounds to its magazine capacity, and improves its durability by 20 shots. It can be further upgraded to Il Toro IV or recycled for salvage.

items.name: Il Toro IV
items.description: Has a large bullet spread, sharp falloff, and high damage output.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Il Toro IV is an advanced version of the Il Toro shotgun, designed for close-range combat. It is built upon the Il Toro III, providing a significantly increased fire rate, a larger magazine, and enhanced durability. This pump-action weapon uses ammunition and is effective for defeating enemies at close distances.

To obtain the Il Toro IV, you must upgrade an existing Il Toro III at a Gunsmith. The base Il Toro I can be crafted at a Workbench once you have learned the Il Toro Blueprint, or sometimes purchased from Tian Wen. You may also find Il Toro shotguns by scavenging in various areas. It can be repaired with materials to restore its durability.

items.name: Impure ARC Coolant
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: Impure ARC Coolant is a less refined form of ARC Coolant that serves as a general resource for crafting. Its primary purpose is to be recycled into crafting materials. Raiders obtain this item by scavenging ARC husks.

items.name: Industrial Battery
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Industrial Battery is a rare item used to upgrade the Gear Bench. It can also be recycled for materials. You can find this item by scavenging in the Dam Battlegrounds map. Specifically, look in the Hydroponic Dome Complex, within the Power Generation Complex on shelves or carts, and in car hoods.

items.name: Industrial Charger
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Industrial Charger is a rare item. It serves as an ingredient for various projects, helping you complete different requirements. You can also recycle this item to gain useful crafting materials and components. To keep track of items required for your projects, you might find the Needed Items Tracker helpful.

items.name: Industrial Magnet
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Industrial Magnet is a rare item used to craft various items and obtain materials through recycling.

items.name: Insulation Roll
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.

items.name: Integrated Binoculars
items.description: Can be equipped and used like regular binoculars, but cannot be dropped or removed from their slot.

items.name: Integrated Defibrillator
items.description: Reusable Defibrillator on a fixed cooldown. Can be used like a normal Defibrillator, but cannot be dropped or removed from its slot.

items.name: Integrated Shield Recharger
items.description: Reusable Shield Recharger on a fixed cooldown. Can be used like a normal Shield Recharger, but cannot be dropped or removed from its slot.

items.name: Ion Sputter
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Ion Sputter is a resource item used in various crafting projects and can be recycled to gain crafting materials. It is required for a specific stage of the Expedition 2 project. This item is also needed for the With A View quest. You can find Ion Sputters by scavenging in the Stella Montis map.

items.name: Jolt Mine
items.description: A proximity-triggered mine that pops up and stuns anything within its radius.
items.article:
The Jolt Mine is a throwable device that helps you control ARC movement. It activates when an ARC gets close, stunning ARCs for 7 seconds and other Raiders for 4 seconds within a 5-meter area after a short delay.

You can craft it at an Explosives Station once you have learned the Jolt Mine Blueprint. It can also be purchased from Apollo for 2,550 coins, with a limit of 3 per day.

items.name: Jolt Mine Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Jolt Mine
items.article: The Jolt Mine Blueprint is a blueprint that, when used, unlocks the ability to craft the Jolt Mine. Once you learn it in Speranza, the blueprint is consumed. You can find this blueprint by scavenging from Industrial Containers across any map, or it can be obtained as a reward for completing Weekly Trials. Blueprints you have already learned are marked and cannot be used again. If you have extra blueprints, they can be sold for 5,000 coins.

items.name: Junior (Outfit)
items.description: This is the Junior cosmetic outfit
items.article: The Junior Outfit is a cosmetic item that changes the appearance of your Raider. This outfit has different versions and can also include a backpack. Raiders obtain it by playing three raids in The Finals.

items.name: Jupiter
items.description: Fires projectiles at an incredible velocity, capable of damaging multiple targets with one shot.
items.flavor_text: Very effective against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Jupiter is a bolt-action sniper rifle that deals a lot of damage with each shot and uses ammunition. This weapon can penetrate ARC armor, which helps in damaging larger ARCs and hitting their weak points. Raiders need to time their shots carefully due to a slight delay before firing.

You can craft the Jupiter at a Gunsmith station once you have learned the Jupiter Blueprint. It can also be found inside a Harvester. When it needs repairs, it costs certain resources. You can also recycle it to obtain salvage materials.

items.name: Jupiter Blueprint
items.description: Fires projectiles at an incredible velocity, capable of damaging multiple targets with one shot.
items.article: The Jupiter Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Jupiter at a Gunsmith bench. Raiders obtain this blueprint by solving the Harvester puzzle protected by the Queen during the Harvester minor map condition.

items.name: Kettle I
items.description: Quick and accurate, but has low bullet velocity and takes a long time to reload.
items.flavor_text: Weak against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Kettle I is a semi-automatic assault rifle that fires ammunition. This weapon is used for combat.

You can obtain the Kettle I by crafting it at the Gunsmith. It is also available for purchase from Tian Wen. Additionally, Raiders might receive it as part of a Free Loadout kit. It can be recycled for materials.

items.name: Kettle II
items.description: Quick and accurate, but has low bullet velocity and takes a long time to reload.
items.flavor_text: Weak against ARC armor plating
items.article: The Kettle II is an upgraded semi-automatic assault rifle that uses light ammo. It improves upon the Kettle I by offering faster bullet velocity and reduced reload time, along with increased durability, making it more effective in combat. Raiders can craft it at a Gunsmith by upgrading a Kettle I with additional components.

items.name: Kettle III
items.description: Quick and accurate, but has low bullet velocity and takes a long time to reload.
items.flavor_text: Weak against ARC armor plating
items.article: The Kettle III is an upgraded semi-automatic assault rifle that uses light ammo. This version of the Kettle offers improved bullet velocity, faster reloading, and increased durability compared to earlier models, making it a more effective weapon for combat. You can craft it at Gunsmith. Once obtained, it can be repaired using materials to restore its durability, recycled to recover resources, or sold for coins.

items.name: Kettle IV
items.description: Quick and accurate, but has low bullet velocity and takes a long time to reload.
items.flavor_text: Weak against ARC armor plating
items.article: Kettle IV is the most refined version of the Kettle semi-automatic assault rifle. It is designed for accuracy and quick firing, using light ammo. This upgraded version offers a significant increase in bullet velocity, a faster reload speed, and improved durability compared to previous Kettle models. Raiders craft it at a Gunsmith by upgrading a Kettle III using crafting materials. It can also be recycled for resources or sold for coins.

items.name: Kinetic Converter
items.description: Moderately increases fire rate.

stat_block.compatibleWeapons: Rattler, Kettle, Ferro, Renegade, Hullcracker

items.flavor_text: 20% Increased Horizontal Recoil
items.article: The Kinetic Converter is a weapon modification designed to alter how your weapon functions. Its primary effect is to increase your weapon's rate of fire. When attached, it will also cause your weapon to experience increased horizontal and vertical recoil during use. This modification can be recycled to recover various resources and other materials.

items.name: Laboratory Reagents
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: Laboratory Reagents are a crafting material used to upgrade the Explosives Station. These reagents can be found by scavenging in medical areas. They can also be recycled into general crafting materials.

items.name: Lance's Mixtape (5th edition)
items.description: Lance has personally planted a number of these around the Rust Belt, for some reason.
items.article: Lance's Mixtape (5th Edition) can be sold for coins.

items.name: Laser Level
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.

items.name: Laser Trap: Lure
items.description: A deployable laser trip wire that detonates a Lure Grenade.
items.article: The Laser Trap: Lure is a blueprint that teaches you how to create a special trap. It sets up a laser tripwire that stretches up to 5 meters. When anything crosses this laser, the trap activates and releases a lure, which helps draw nearby ARCs towards its location. The trap can only be disarmed and picked up by the Raider who placed it, unless another Raider has the Minesweeper skill.

items.name: Launcher Ammo
items.description: Anti-ARC payloads used mainly by the Hullcracker.
items.flavor_text: Compatible with Hullcracker
items.article:
Launcher Ammo is a type of ammunition used by specific weapons, such as the Hullcracker and the Rascal. It features an explosive payload designed to effectively penetrate ARC armor, providing a stronger option than Heavy Ammo.

  • It can be scavenged from the environment.
  • It is obtained by looting arcs like the Turbine and Bombardier.
  • Raiders can craft it at the Workbench using salvage materials.
  • It is also available for purchase from Tian Wen.

items.name: Leaper Pulse Unit
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article:
The Leaper Pulse Unit is a throwable device that creates a temporary damaging singularity, affecting both ARCs and Raiders within its area. After being used, a damaged unit can be retrieved.

You obtain this item by salvaging defeated Leapers. It is also needed for upgrading the Utility Station and completing the Into The Fray quest. It can also be recycled for resources.

items.name: Lemon
items.description: Can be consumed for a small amount of stamina.
items.article: Lemon is a resource in the game. It is often mentioned alongside apricot in discussions and guides that highlight specific locations where these items can be found.

items.name: “Leviathan's Crown” Ship Model
items.description: A majestic sight in any era, this fierce merchant ship is indifferent to the aerodynamic benefits of fiberglass technology.
items.article: The "Leviathan's Crown" Ship Model is a unique trinket primarily used for decoration. Its main purpose is to allow Raiders to personalize their Raider Den by displaying it within their stash and it also sells for a pretty penny.

items.name: Library Book
items.description: A literary masterpiece filled with fantastical worlds, callously earmarked by some uncultured oaf.

items.name: LiDAR Scanner
items.description: A laser-based scanner used to detect the subtlest changes to the Earth's surface
items.article: A Lidar Scanner is a specialized device used to monitor ground tremors and gather data. Its primary purpose is to help complete the Eyes In The Sky quest. During this quest, you install it at high points, such as the Communications Tower in the Spaceport, to get a clear signal.

items.name: Light Ammo
items.description: Light bullets used mainly with SMGs and light handguns. Such as Kettle, Stitcher, Burletta, Hairpin and Bobcat.
items.article: Light Ammo is a type of ammunition used by low-caliber weapons. This ammo type is not very good at going through ARC armor. You can obtain Light Ammo in several ways: by finding it through scavenging, by opening a Raider Cache, or by looting arcs like the Turret or Wasp. It can also be crafted at a Workbench from general resources or bought from Tian Wen.

items.name: Light Bulb
items.description: Without light, life underground would be impossible.
items.article:
The Light Bulb is an uncommon trinket item. It is a necessary component for completing various projects, such as Expedition 1 and Expedition 2.

You can find these by scavenging in the Electrical Substation area of the Dam Battlegrounds map, frequently appearing inside cars and car hoods. They are also present in car hoods near the Extraction Lift in the Generator Hall area of the Dam Battlegrounds map. Additionally, look for them within loot containers and industrial loot containers at Pilgrim's Peak in The Blue Gate map.

items.name: Light Gun Parts
items.description: Assorted spare parts used for pistols and SMGs.
items.article: Light Gun Parts are assorted spare parts used for pistols and SMGs. They are used to upgrade, craft, and repair weapons that use Light Ammo. You can craft this item at the Refiner after learning the Light Gun Parts Blueprint. Additionally, Celeste sells this item in limited quantities for coins each day. This item can also be recycled into other resources.

items.name: Light Gun Parts Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft Light Gun Parts

items.name: Light Impact Grenade
items.description: A grenade that detonates on impact, dealing explosive damage in a small radius.
items.article: The Light Impact Grenade is a throwable item that explodes on contact, damaging anything nearby in a small area. While it may not deal as much damage as other explosives, it is inexpensive to create. Raiders can craft it at an Explosives Station level 1 or Workbench, or even during a raid if they have the In-Round Crafting skill. It can also be purchased from Apollo or recycled for resources.

items.name: Light Shield
items.description: A lightweight shield that blocks a small portion of incoming damage without impacting mobility.
items.article: The Light Shield is a lightweight piece of defensive gear that provides protection from incoming damage without impacting your mobility. You can find this shield through scavenging, craft it at a Workbench and a Gear Bench, or purchase it from Lance. Its durability can be restored through repairs.

items.name: Lightweight Stock
items.description: Moderately improves ADS & draw speed.

stat_block.compatibleWeapons: Rattler, Kettle, Ferro, Renegade, Hullcracker

items.article: The Lightweight Stock is a weapon mod that helps you aim down sights and equip or unequip your weapon faster. To get one, you first need to acquire the Lightweight Stock blueprint. Once you have the blueprint, you can craft it at a Gunsmith. If you no longer need it, you can recycle it for salvage or coins.

items.name: Lightweight Stock Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Lightweight Stock
items.article: The Lightweight Stock Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Lightweight Stock. This weapon modification helps improve the speed at which you aim down sights and ready your weapon. You can craft it at the Gunsmith Bench level 3 using a combination of different materials.

items.name: Li'l Smoke Grenade
items.description: A grenade that pops a thick but small smoke cloud on impact, blocking visibility from ARC and other Raiders.
items.article: The Li'l Smoke Grenade is a throwable item that creates a small, thick smoke cloud when it explodes. This smoke blocks visibility for ARCs and other Raiders within a 2.5-meter radius for 6 seconds, helping you avoid detection or move unseen. You can craft this item at a Utility Station, or during a raid if you have the appropriate Inventory Skill. It can also be recycled into basic resources.

items.name: Looting Mk. 1
items.description: Basic looting augment. More backpack slots and weight capacity, but low defensive and tactical capability.
items.article:
The Looting Mk. 1 is an augment that increases the number of items you can carry in your backpack and raises your total weight capacity. It is designed to work with light shields.

You can obtain this augment in a few ways: Lance offers a free exchange service where you can trade a Free Loadout Augment for it, and you can also buy it directly from Lance. Additionally, it can be crafted at a Workshop or Gear Bench.

items.name: Looting Mk. 2
items.description: Significantly increases looting potential; adds slots for trinkets.
items.flavor_text: Automatically throws off attached Ticks after 1s.
items.article: The Looting Mk. 2 is a Looting Augment that helps you gather more items during your expeditions. It significantly increases your backpack capacity and the total weight you can carry. This augment also features a unique ability to automatically remove any Ticks attached to you after a brief moment, provides two Safe Pocket slots, and has three dedicated slots for trinkets. You can only use this augment with a light shield. It is crafted at Gear Bench using salvage.

items.name: Looting Mk. 3 (Cautious)
items.description: A looting augment that swaps some carry capacity to increase survivability.
items.flavor_text: Upon Shield break, automatically administers a weak Adrenaline Shot. Has a fixed cooldown.
items.article: The Looting MK. 3 (Cautious) is an augment designed to help Raiders survive by reducing some carry capacity in favor of defensive benefits. When your shield breaks, it automatically administers a weak adrenaline shot, which then has a fixed cooldown before it can be used again. This augment includes built-in binoculars, allows for a maximum loadout weight of 70.0, and has Light shield compatibility. You can craft this augment at a Gear Bench. It can be recycled for resources or salvaged for components, and also repaired using various materials.

items.name: Looting Mk. 3 (Safekeeper)
items.description: A looting augment that trades weight and utility for increased looting potential.
items.flavor_text: A Safe Pocket that allows any item to be stored.
items.article: The Looting Mk. 3 (Safekeeper) is an augment that provides a secure pocket, allowing you to safely store any items you find. This augment allows you to Safe-pocket a weapon - something other augments do not allow. You craft this augment at a Gear Bench after obtaining its blueprint. The Looting Mk. 3 (Safekeeper) Blueprint has been found in the Reinforced Reception area.

items.name: Looting Mk. 3 (Safekeeper) Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft the Looting Mk. 3 (Safekeeper) Augment.
items.article: The Looting MK. 3 (Safekeeper) Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to create an augment at Gear Bench. This augment provides a secure pocket for storing items found during raids and specifically allows you to Safe-pocket a weapon - something other augments do not allow.

items.name: Looting Mk. 3 (Survivor)
items.description: A heavy-duty pack mule augment. Large weight capacity and large backpack space.
items.flavor_text: While downed and stationary, health regenerates up to 75% of max downed health.
items.article: The Looting MK. 3 (Survivor) is an Augment that increases your carrying capacity and backpack space. It also has a special ability: if you get downed and stay still, your health will regenerate up to 75% of your maximum downed health.

items.name: Looting Mk. 3 (Survivor) Blueprint
items.description: A heavy-duty pack mule augment. Large weight capacity and large backpack space.
items.article: The Looting Mk. 3 (Survivor) Blueprint allows you to craft the Looting Mk. 3 (Survivor) augment at a Gear Bench. It increases your carry weight and backpack space, and provides a benefit where you can regenerate up to 75% of your health when you are downed and staying still.

items.name: Lure Grenade
items.description: A noisy device that sticks to surfaces, distracting nearby ARC machines and drawing their fire.
items.article: The Lure Grenade is a throwable item designed to create a loud noise, drawing the attention of nearby ARCs. Raiders can use this to distract ARCs and redirect their attacks, providing an opportunity to escape or reposition. Its blueprint is rewarded upon completing the Greasing Her Palms quest and can be crafted at a utility station.

items.name: Lure Grenade Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Lure Grenade
items.article: The Lure Grenade Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft Lure Grenades at a Utility Station. These grenades create noise to distract nearby ARCs, making them focus their attacks on the grenade instead of you. This blueprint is obtained as a reward from completing the Greasing Her Palms quest.

items.name: Lure Grenade Trap
items.description: A laser trip wire that detonates a Lure Grenade.
items.article: The Lure Grenade Trap is a device that projects a visible red laser trip wire. When the laser is broken, it detonates a grenade, creating a loud siren that draws the attention of nearby ARCs towards the trap. This helps Raiders distract ARCs away from their position or towards a chosen area. Raiders can craft this trap at a Workbench. If the trap has not detonated, the Raider who placed it can disarm and recover it.

items.name: Magazine Geometry 101
