items.description: Shotgun engagements against drones offer a useful test of stopping power. Concentrating the full charge into a single projectile could produce far more decisive results.

items.name: Spaceport Container Storage Key
items.description: Unlocks a door in the Container Storage in Spaceport
items.article: The Spaceport Container Storage Key is a key used to open specific locked doors. Its primary use is to unlock one of three doors found on the east side of the Container Storage area in the Spaceport map. These particular doors are located on the top floor of the Container Storage. You can find this key while exploring the map, or by completing the quest called Switching The Supply.

items.name: Spaceport Control Tower Key
items.description: Unlocks a door in Control Tower A6 in Spaceport
items.article: The Spaceport Control Tower Key is an access item that allows you to open a specific locked area. Its main purpose is to unlock the Control Tower in the Spaceport map, which Raiders often seek for its contents. It functions similarly to the Blue Gate Communication Tower Key, providing entry to an otherwise inaccessible tower.

items.name: Spaceport Trench Tower Key
items.description: Unlocks a door to the Trench Towers in Spaceport
items.article: The Spaceport Trench Tower Key is a specific key used to open secured trench tower buildings located within the Spaceport map. This key allows Raiders to access areas that might contain valuable items or provide a way to complete objectives. It is sometimes also referred to as a Spaceport Control Tower Key, indicating its purpose in granting entry to these fortified structures.

items.name: Spaceport Warehouse Key
items.description: Unlocks a door in the Shipping Warehouse in Spaceport
items.article: The Spaceport Warehouse Key is a key that allows you to open a specific set of locked doors. These doors are found on the North side of the Shipping Warehouse, located on the Second Floor of the Spaceport map.

items.name: Speaker Component
items.description: Used in crafting.
items.article:
A Speaker Component is a resource used for crafting various utility items. You can use it at a Utility Station or with the 'Traveling Tinkerer' Inventory Skill to create different helpful items. This component can also be recycled into other resources.

You can obtain Speaker Components in several ways:

  • Scavenged from containers or the environment.
  • Obtained by recycling or salvaging other items.
  • Purchased directly from Celeste.

items.name: Spectrometer
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Spectrometer is a rare item. Its primary use is to be recycled into crafting materials that can then be used in various projects. You can find this item by scavenging throughout the environment in the Stella Montis map.

items.name: Spectrum Analyzer
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Spectrum Analyzer is used to obtain valuable crafting materials. Its primary purpose is to be recycled into general materials that help you make other items. Raiders can find it by scavenging in the Stella Montis map.

items.name: Spotter Relay
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article:
The Spotter Relay is used to progress the Trophy Display Project. When deployed, it functions as a trap that lures nearby ARCs. It is a key component for Stage 2 of the Trophy Display Project and is also needed for the quest Combat Recon. You can track all project needs on the Needed Items Tracker.

Obtain Spotter Relays by destroying Spotter Drones, which only spawn when a Bombardier ARC is active nearby. They are found on Spaceport and Buried City maps, but the north-west section of the Blue Gate map offers the most consistent encounters.

items.name: Spring Cushion
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Spring Cushion can be broken down into useful components. Its main purpose is to provide general crafting materials when you recycle it. You can find this item by searching containers like trash cans, which are commonly located in Residential and Commercial areas.

items.name: Stable Stock I
items.description: Slightly improves dispersion & recoil recovery time.
items.article: Stable Stock I is a weapon mod. It helps Raiders manage how much their weapon kicks back after firing and how spread out their shots are.

items.name: Stable Stock II
items.description: Moderately improves dispersion & recoil recovery time.

stat_block.compatibleWeapons: Ferro, Kettle, Rattler, Stitcher, Arpeggio, Il Toro, Osprey, Renegade, Torrente, Bettina, Bobcat, Tempest, Vulcano, Aphelion

items.article:
The Stable Stock II is a weapon modification that helps make your weapon more stable. It allows your weapon to recover faster after you fire and reduces how much your shots spread.

To obtain this item, craft it at a Gunsmith Bench level 1 using a Stable Stock II Blueprint.

items.name: Stable Stock II Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Stable Stock II
items.article: The Stable Stock II Blueprint is a blueprint that teaches you how to craft the Stable Stock II weapon modification at a Gunsmith. Once learned, it improves how your gun handles by making it recover faster from recoil and spread. This blueprint can be found through scavenging, often appearing in Raider Containers across any map. It can also be obtained as a reward for completing quests or by succeeding in trials.

items.name: Stable Stock III
items.description: Significantly improves dispersion & recoil recovery time.

stat_block.compatibleWeapons: Rattler, Kettle, Ferro, Renegade, Hullcracker

items.article:
The Stable Stock III is a Weapon Mod that greatly improves how quickly your weapon becomes steady again after recoil and how fast its accuracy returns after shooting. Keep in mind that attaching this mod will slightly increase the time it takes to ready your weapon and put it away.

You can craft this mod at a Gunsmith bench, but you will need to have the Stable Stock III Blueprint first.

items.name: Stable Stock III Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Stable Stock III
items.article:
The Stable Stock III Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Stable Stock III weapon modification at a Gunsmith Bench. This modification improves weapon handling by reducing shot spread and recoil recovery time.

You can find this blueprint:

  • Inside containers like Boxes, Ammo Crates, Breachable Containers, and Lockers.
  • Across maps such as the Spaceport, Blue Gate, Dam Battlegrounds, Buried City, and Riven Tides.
  • During events including Cold Snap, Electromagnetic Storm, Night Raid, Hurricane, and Locked Gate.

Recycling the blueprint yields coins.

items.name: Stack of Movie Tapes
items.description: A stack of movie tapes, sure to please even the most pedantic of cinephiles.
items.article: A Stack of Movie Tapes is a special item Raiders might carry in their inventory when participating in certain game events. It is linked to events such as the Flickering Flames Event and the Movie Night quest. During these events, Raiders typically collect items, and the Stack of Movie Tapes likely represents their progress or completion of these event-related tasks.

items.name: Statuette
items.description: Worth a small fortune.
items.article: The Statuette is a small trinket. Its main purpose is to be sold for coins, offering a good amount of value. You can find Statuettes by scavenging in areas like Old World Residential.

items.name: Steel Cable
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.

items.name: Steel Spring
items.description: Used to craft a wide range of items. Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: Steel Spring is a material used in crafting. Its main purpose is to create various weapon modifications at the Gunsmith bench and other components at the Refiner. It is also a necessary component to complete the Expedition project. You can find Steel Spring by scavenging in the environment or by opening Metal Crates. It can also be purchased from Celeste.

items.name: Stella Montis Archives Key
items.description: Unlocks a door in the Archives in Stella Montis
items.article: The Stella Montis Archives Key is a key used to unlock the Archives area found within the Stella Montis map. This key provides access to a specific, otherwise restricted section of the map, allowing Raiders to explore it.

items.name: Stella Montis Assembly Admin Key
items.description: Unlocks a door in Assembly in Stella Montis
items.article: The Stella Montis Assembly Admin Key is a key used to unlock a specific door within the Assembly area of the Stella Montis map. Raiders use this key to access new sections of the map that are otherwise inaccessible. It can be carried one at a time, weighs 0.25kg, and has a value of 100 coins.

items.name: Stella Montis Medical Storage Key
items.description: Unlocks a door in Medical Research in Stella Montis
items.article: The Stella Montis Medical Storage Key is a key used to unlock the Medical Storage door located within the Stella Montis map. Gaining entry to this storage typically allows Raiders to find helpful resources or items inside.

items.name: Stella Montis Security Checkpoint Key
items.description: Unlocks a door in the Security Checkpoint in Stella Montis
items.article: The Stella Montis Security Checkpoint Key is a key used to open security checkpoints within the Stella Montis map. Raiders use this key to gain access to areas that are otherwise locked by these checkpoints.

items.name: Stencil Parts
items.description: Used to apply stencils to weapons.

items.name: Sterilized Bandage
items.description: A medical item that gradually restores a large amount health over time.
items.article: The Sterilized Bandage is a medical item that gradually restores a large amount of health over time. Raiders can craft this item at the Medical Lab.

items.name: Stiletto Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Stiletto

items.name: Stiletto I
items.description: Semi-automatic rifle with high accuracy, good handling and low initial recoil, but becomes harder to handle with sustained fire.

items.name: Stiletto II
items.description: Semi-automatic rifle with high accuracy, good handling and low initial recoil, but becomes harder to handle with sustained fire.

items.name: Stiletto III
items.description: Semi-automatic rifle with high accuracy, good handling and low initial recoil, but becomes harder to handle with sustained fire.

items.name: Stiletto IV
items.description: Semi-automatic rifle with high accuracy, good handling and low initial recoil, but becomes harder to handle with sustained fire.

items.name: Stitcher I
items.description: Has a good damage output, but has a low fire-rate for an SMG, and can be hard to control.
items.flavor_text: Weak against ARC armor plating
items.article: The Stitcher I is a fully-automatic Submachine Gun that uses light ammo. Raiders might receive this weapon when choosing a Free Loadout, or they can find it by scavenging. It can also be crafted at the Workbench once Gunsmith is available, or purchased from Tian Wen. It can be used to craft improved versions and can also be recycled for resources.

items.name: Stitcher II
items.description: Has a good damage output, but has a low fire-rate for an SMG, and can be hard to control.
items.flavor_text: Weak against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Stitcher II is a fully-automatic Submachine Gun that uses light ammo. It is an improved version of the Stitcher I, offering less horizontal recoil, faster reload speed, and increased durability.

Raiders can craft the Stitcher II at a Gunsmith Bench by combining one Stitcher I with salvage materials. It can also be obtained as part of a Free Loadout or purchased from Tian Wen. The weapon sells for 2,000 coins.

items.name: Stitcher III
items.description: Has a good damage output, but has a low fire-rate for an SMG, and can be hard to control.
items.flavor_text: Weak against ARC armor plating
items.article: The Stitcher III is an upgraded fully-automatic submachine gun that improves upon the Stitcher II. It offers better weapon control with reduced horizontal recoil, faster reload times, and improved durability compared to its previous version. Raiders primarily obtain this weapon by crafting it at a Gunsmith from other components. It can be recycled for useful materials and resources.

items.name: Stitcher IV
items.description: Has a good damage output, but has a low fire-rate for an SMG, and can be hard to control.
items.flavor_text: Weak against ARC armor plating
items.article: The Stitcher IV is an advanced, fully-automatic submachine gun that uses light ammo. It is an improved version of the Stitcher III, offering enhanced combat performance. This weapon provides significantly reduced horizontal recoil, faster reload times, and increased durability, making it more reliable in engagements. It can be crafted at the Gunsmith Bench level 1. If no longer needed, it can be recycled for valuable resources or sold for 5,000 coins.

items.name: Succulent (Backpack Charm)
items.description: Complete the quest The Root Of The Matter to get this charm.
items.article: The Succulent (Backpack Charm) is a cosmetic item used to customize your Raider's appearance. It attaches to the bottom of your backpack and swings as you move, adding a unique visual detail. To get this charm, you need to complete the The Root Of The Matter quest.

items.name: Surge Coil
items.description: A deployable device that periodically electrifies the area around itself and briefly stuns anything caught within it.
items.article: The Surge Coil is a deployable device that periodically electrifies the area around itself, briefly stunning anything caught within it. It also causes ARCs to redirect their attention towards it, much like a Lure Grenade. This item can be found by scavenging or crafted at the Explosives Station once you have learned its Surge Coil Blueprint. The blueprint can be obtained by looting arcs.

items.name: Surge Coil Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Surge Coil.
items.article:
The Surge Coil Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Surge Coil, a deployable device that electrifies the area around it. When placed, it periodically sends out an electric pulse that briefly stuns both ARCs and other Raiders who come too close. This can be useful for controlling areas, buying extra time during combat or looting, and escaping fast-moving ARCs like Shredders.

You can find the Surge Coil Blueprint by looting various containers, such as lockers, desk drawers, cupboards, and industrial crates, during the Electromagnetic Storm map condition. You must be in a map where this condition is active. Check the Event Timers to see when the Electromagnetic Storm is running on any map. It has been reported to drop in areas like the Testing Annex, Water Treatment Facility, and Hydroponic Domes within the Dam Battlegrounds, among others.

items.name: Surge Shield Recharger
items.description: A handheld kit that recharges a shield on use.
items.article: The Surge Shield Recharger is a handheld kit used to instantly restore 50 shield charge after a brief moment, which helps you stay protected during engagements. This item is crafted at a Medical Lab using other resources.

items.name: Surveyor Vault
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: A Surveyor Vault is a rare item used to improve your crafting abilities and complete certain projects. You will need it to upgrade your Medical Lab to level 3, which is a station found in your Hideout. It is also a requirement for the first stage of the Trophy Display project. You can obtain Surveyor Vaults by looting arcs such as the Surveyor or Courier. Additionally, you can recycle them to gain crafting materials or salvage them for resources.

items.name: Synthesized Fuel
items.description: Used to craft utility items and explosives. Can be recycled into chemicals.
items.article: Synthesized Fuel is a material used to craft explosives and other helpful items. You can also throw it, and if it gets shot, it will explode, causing damage in a small area. This material is also important for improving your Explosives Station level 1. You can find Synthesized Fuel by scavenging in the environment or by recycling other items. Additionally, Celeste sells a limited amount of Synthesized Fuel each day for coins. If you have extra, you can recycle it to get various resources.

items.name: Syringe
items.description: Used to craft medical supplies. Can be recycled into plastic.
items.article:
A Syringe is a sterile item used to craft medical supplies and is also required for the Doctor's Orders quest.

Raiders can find Syringes in containers such as bags and medical crates across Buried City, Dam Battlegrounds, Blue Gate, and Stella Montis. The trader Celeste also sells them in Dam Battlegrounds for coins. Alternatively, you can obtain a Syringe by recycling salvage.

When no longer needed, a Syringe can be recycled into crafting materials.

items.name: Tactical Mk. 1
items.description: Basic tactical augment. More Quick Use slots for more tactical choice, but limited survivability and slightly lower looting potential.
items.article:
The Tactical Mk. 1 is an Augment that adds more Quick Use slots, allowing you to carry more tactical items. While it offers five Quick Use slots and compatibility with a medium shield, it has fewer backpack slots and a lower maximum weight capacity.

You can get the Tactical Mk. 1 in a few ways. Lance offers it as a free exchange if you provide a Free Loadout Augment, or you can purchase it from him directly. It can also be crafted at a Gear Bench. Additionally, you might find this Augment by scavenging.

items.name: Tactical Mk. 2
items.description: Adds more backpack space and an extra utility item slot.
items.flavor_text: Upon Shield break, deploys a small smoke grenade. Has a fixed cooldown.
items.article: The Tactical Mk. 2 is a type of Augment that increases your backpack space and provides an additional slot for utility items. It also has a unique ability: if your shield breaks, it automatically deploys a small smoke grenade after a short cooldown. This augment is an improved version of the Tactical Mk. 1. You can craft it at a Gear Bench, and it can be repaired or recycled into general resources.

items.name: Tactical Mk. 3 (Defensive)
items.description: A defense-focused augment for keeping Shields topped up.
items.flavor_text: Allows Shield Rechargers to be used while running.
items.article:
The Tactical Mk.3 (Defensive) is an augment designed to help Raiders keep their shields full. Its main feature is a built-in shield recharger, which allows you to recharge your shields even while running. This augment also works with light, medium, and heavy shields, offering broad compatibility.

This augment can be crafted at Gear Bench once its blueprint has been learned. Blueprints for it can be found through scavenging. It can also be recycled into other resources or repaired.

items.name: Tactical Mk. 3 (Defensive) Blueprint
items.description: a defense-focused augment for keeping Shields topped up
items.article: The Tactical MK.3 (Defensive) Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Tactical Mk.3 (Defensive) augment at a Gear Bench. It helps keep your shields full, letting you use a Shield Recharger even while running.

items.name: Tactical Mk. 3 (Healing)
items.description: A healing-focused augment which adds extra slots for healing items.
items.flavor_text: When revived from being downed, releases a healing cloud that restores 20 health over 10 seconds. Has a 30-second cooldown.
items.article:
The Tactical Mk. 3 (Healing) is a tactical augment designed to improve a Raider's healing capabilities. It provides additional slots for carrying healing items in both your backpack and safe pockets. When you are revived after being downed, it releases a healing cloud that instantly restores 45 health to you and nearby Raiders. This ability has a 45-second cooldown.

This augment's Blueprint is found by participating in the Locked Gate event. Once you have the Blueprint, you can craft it at a Gear Bench. The augment can also be recycled to recover general resources.

items.name: Tactical Mk. 3 (Healing) Blueprint
items.description: A healing-focused augment which adds extra slots for healing items.
items.article: The Tactical MK.3 (Healing) Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft a specialized augment designed for healing at Gear Bench. When equipped, the augment provides more capacity for healing items and, upon being revived from a downed state, creates a healing cloud that instantly restores 45 health. This effect has a 45-second cooldown. It can also be recycled for resources or salvaged for components.

items.name: Tactical Mk. 3 (Revival)
items.description: A tactical augment focused on utility over defense and looting.
items.flavor_text: Restores 1 health every 5 seconds. When damage is taken, the effect is paused for 30 seconds.
items.article:
The Tactical Mk. 3 (Revival) is an Augment that helps Raiders stay in the fight and support their teammates. It provides a slow regeneration, restoring 1 health every 5 seconds, though this effect pauses for 30 seconds if you take damage. This Augment also comes with an integrated defibrillator, which has unlimited uses but requires a 240-second cooldown period after each revival.

It can be crafted at Gear Bench using the Tactical Mk. 3 (Revival) Blueprint. The blueprint itself can be obtained by participating in the Locked Gate event. Once crafted, it can be recycled to recover some general resources.

items.name: Tactical Mk. 3 (Revival) Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft Tactical MK. 3 (Revival) Blueprint.
items.article: The Tactical Mk. 3 (Revival) Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Tactical Mk. 3 (Revival) augment at a Gear Bench. It comes with an integrated defibrillator, offering a utility option for use during raids. You can obtain this blueprint by participating in the Locked Gate event.

items.name: Tactical Mk. 3 (Smoke)
items.description: An upgraded version of the Tactical MK. 2 augment, adding expanded capacity across the board.
items.article: The Tactical Mk. 3 (Smoke) is an augment that automatically deploys a small smoke grenade when your shield breaks, providing a defensive cover. It is an improved version of the Tactical Mk. 2 augment, offering more capacity. This augment can be used with Light and Medium shields. You can obtain this item by scavenging in the environment or by crafting it at a Gear Bench once you have learned its blueprint. It has a maximum loadout weight of 50.0.

items.name: Tactical Mk. 3 (Smoke) Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a T3 Smoke Augment
items.article: The Tactical MK.3 (Smoke) Blueprint is a blueprint used to craft the Tactical Mk. 3 (Smoke) augment at a Gear Bench. It automatically deploys a small smoke grenade when your shield breaks, which can provide momentary cover.

items.name: Tagging Grenade
items.description: A grenade that detonates after a delay, tagging Raiders and ARC enemies in an area, allowing you to briefly track their location.
items.article:
The Tagging Grenade is a utility item that helps you locate ARCs and other Raiders. When thrown, it detonates after a short delay, revealing the positions of ARCs and other Raiders within a 6-meter area for 30 seconds. This allows you to track their movements, which can help you plan your next steps or avoid being surprised.

You can craft this grenade at the Utility Station once you have learned the Tagging Grenade Blueprint.

items.name: Tagging Grenade Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Tagging Grenade
items.article: The Tagging Grenade Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft Tagging Grenades at a Utility Station. Once thrown, it detonates to briefly reveal the locations of ARCs and other Raiders in its blast area.

items.name: Tangerine (Warden Color)
items.description: A new cosmetic variant will be added to your collection.
items.article: Tangerine (Warden Color) is a cosmetic item for your collection. It provides a new color choice for the Warden outfit, letting you change the appearance of your character's clothing.

items.name: Targeted Component Trial
items.description: Even the toughest machines have their weak spots. Consistent strikes against vulnerable components could reveal a way to develop rounds that hit them where it hurts most. Metaphorically speaking.

items.name: Tattered ARC Lining
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: Tattered ARC Lining is a material that was once an intact ARC Thermo Lining. Raiders use it for recycling into general crafting materials. You can obtain this item by scavenging the husks of ARCs.

items.name: Tattered Clothes
items.description: Can be recycled into fabric.
items.article: Tattered Clothes are an Uncommon item primarily used to gather essential crafting materials. You can recycle them to obtain various resources needed for different projects and upgrades. These clothes are typically found by scavenging through residential areas, rather than as drops from ARCs.

items.name: Telemetry Transceiver
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Telemetry Transceiver is primarily used for recycling into crafting materials. You can obtain it by scavenging inside containers, which are commonly found in the Stella Montis map, and sometimes also in the Dam Battlegrounds map. When recycled, it provides resources for crafting and a base value of 2250 coins.

items.name: Tellurion
items.description: A marvel of ancient ingenuity, those with a penchant for stargazing may find the mesmerizing patterns oddly familiar.

items.name: Tempest Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Tempest
items.article: The Tempest Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Tempest I assault rifle at a Gunsmith. You can obtain it by scavenging in the game world, and it has been found during 'Night Raid' events.

items.name: Tempest I
items.description: Has moderate fire rate and accuracy.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article: The Tempest I is a fully-automatic assault rifle that uses medium ammo. It is a reliable weapon for engaging ARCs. Raiders can craft it at the Gunsmith Bench level 1 after acquiring and learning the Tempest Blueprint. It serves as the initial version of the Tempest weapon series.

items.name: Tempest II
items.description: Has moderate fire rate and accuracy.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article: The Tempest II is an upgraded version of the Tempest I assault rifle. This fully-automatic weapon uses medium ammo and offers improved combat performance over its previous model. It provides reduced horizontal recoil, a faster reload time, and increased durability, while maintaining a moderate fire rate and accuracy. Raiders can obtain it by crafting at the Gunsmith, where a Tempest I is combined with various crafting materials.

items.name: Tempest III
items.description: Has moderate fire rate and accuracy.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article: The Tempest III is an upgraded version of the Tempest II assault rifle, providing enhanced performance. This assault rifle uses medium ammo. When equipped, it offers a noticeable reduction in horizontal recoil and a faster reload speed compared to its previous versions. It also comes with improved durability, allowing for more shots before needing repairs. You can obtain it by upgrading a Tempest II at a Gunsmith bench. It can also be recycled for resources or sold for coins.

items.name: Tempest IV
items.description: Has moderate fire rate and accuracy.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Tempest IV is an advanced assault rifle, representing the highest upgrade level in the Tempest series. This fully-automatic weapon uses medium ammo and significantly improves a Raider's combat capabilities. It offers 50% reduced horizontal recoil, 40% reduced reload time, and increased durability compared to its previous versions.

Raiders obtain the Tempest IV by crafting it at a crafting station that meets the necessary requirements, which involves upgrading a Tempest III. It can be repaired using materials to restore its durability. It can also be sold for 27,000 coins.

items.name: Tether Launcher
items.description: A two-shot tether launcher that anchors a line to whatever it hits, linking both points together.

items.name: Tether Launcher Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Tether Launcher

items.name: Thermal Shaker
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.

items.name: Thermite-Tipped Rounds
items.description: Impact damage is useful. Setting the problem on fire afterward feels like a reasonable improvement.

items.name: Thermostat
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Thermostat is a resource that serves as a crafting material. Its main purpose is to be recycled, providing materials that are important for crafting various other items to help Raiders progress. You can typically find Thermostats by searching and collecting items from different spots located within Residential areas.

items.name: Tick Pod
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Tick Pod is an uncommon item obtained by defeating Ticks. This item is used in various crafting and upgrade processes at the Medical Lab and for upgrading the Medical Lab itself. Tick Pods are also required for a project at the Trophy Display. You can recycle them to obtain crafting materials.

items.name: Toaster
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Toaster is a rare item that serves two main purposes. It is used as a component when crafting advanced equipment at the Refiner, alongside other components. Alternatively, if not needed for crafting, it can be recycled to obtain general crafting materials.

items.name: Top Mounted Optics Retrofittings
items.description: Elevated firing positions provide clear sightlines. Osprey field data under those conditions could support development of improved magnification.

items.name: Torch Ginger
items.description: A plant used to craft medical supplies.
items.article: Torch Ginger is a plant used to craft medical supplies. If you choose to recycle it, you will lose 150 coins.

items.name: Torn Blanket
items.description: Can be recycled into fabric.
items.article: Torn Blanket is a material item that can be processed to obtain other resources. Its main use is to provide crafting components used to create various general supplies and other useful items. This item can be recycled to yield resources, or it can be salvaged for a smaller quantity.

items.name: Torn Book
items.description: What pages remain speak of chosen heroes, vampires, and lots of longing glances.
items.article: The Torn Book is a trinket, primarily used as a quest item. Raiders need this item to successfully complete the Cold Storage quest. Additionally, if you have no immediate need for it, the Torn Book can be sold for coins.

items.name: Torrente Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Torrente
items.article: The Torrente Blueprint is a blueprint that allows Raiders to craft the Torrente weapon.

items.name: Torrente I
items.description: Has a large ammo capacity, but is only accurate while crouched.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article: The Torrente I is a fully-automatic light machine gun that uses medium ammo. This weapon has a large ammunition capacity and provides sustained fire, though it is most accurate when used while crouched. It offers moderate penetration against ARC armor during combat. Raiders craft this item at a Gunsmith after learning the Torrente I Blueprint. Once crafted, it can be further upgraded to more advanced versions or recycled for various resources.

items.name: Torrente II
items.description: Has a large ammo capacity, but is only accurate while crouched.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article: The Torrente II is a fully-automatic Light Machine Gun (LMG) that uses medium ammo. It serves as an improved version of the Torrente I, offering a larger magazine size, faster reloading, and better durability for Raiders. This weapon is crafted at the Gunsmith by combining a Torrente I with other crafting materials.

items.name: Torrente III
items.description: Has a large ammo capacity, but is only accurate while crouched.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Torrente III is an upgraded Light Machine Gun (LMG) that uses medium ammo. This weapon has a large ammo capacity and is most accurate when the Raider is crouching. Compared to earlier versions, it provides an increased magazine size, a faster reload time, and improved durability, making it suitable for sustained combat.

Raiders can craft this LMG at Gunsmith. It can also be recycled for resources or repaired to restore its durability.

items.name: Torrente IV
items.description: Has a large ammo capacity, but is only accurate while crouched.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Torrente IV is an upgraded, fully-automatic Light Machine Gun that uses medium ammo. It is designed for sustained fire with a large ammo capacity. This version provides a significant increase to magazine size, a faster reload time, and improved durability compared to earlier Torrente models.

Raiders can craft it at a Gunsmith using crafting materials. It can also be recycled for resources.

items.name: Trailblazer
items.description: A grenade that emits a trail of flammable gas along its path, causing an explosive chain reaction when it ignites.
items.article:
The Trailblazer Grenade is a throwable item that releases a trail of flammable gas when used. After a moment, the gas ignites, causing an explosion.

Raiders can obtain this grenade in a few ways. It can be found by scavenging. You can also craft it at an Explosives Station level 1, which requires learning its blueprint and using various components. Additionally, it can be purchased from Apollo for 6,600 coins, with a limit of three per day. When no longer needed, it can be recycled for other resources.

items.name: Trailblazer Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Trailblazer Grenade
items.article: The Trailblazer Grenade Blueprint is a blueprint used at an Explosives Station level 1 to craft Trailblazer Grenades. They release a trail of flammable gas along their path, which then ignites and explodes after a short delay.

items.name: Train Model
items.description: Hand-crafted with full underbody detailing, these models offer a surprisingly intricate schematic of pre-Exodus locomotion.

items.name: Trigger 'Nade
items.description: A remote-detonated grenade that can stick to surfaces and ARC, dealing explosive damage when triggered.
items.article:
The Trigger 'Nade is a grenade you throw that sticks to surfaces and ARCs. It does not explode right away; instead, you trigger it remotely to cause an explosion that deals damage in an area.

To get this item, you first need its blueprint, which is given as a reward when you complete the Sparks Fly quest. Once you have it, you can craft this grenade at an Explosives Station.

items.name: Trigger Nade Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Trigger Nade
items.article: The Trigger Nade Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft trigger nades at the appropriate crafting station.

items.name: Trigger Reset Systems
items.description: Fast-moving threats leave little margin for hesitation. Close encounters with Skulkers could reveal ways to improve paced combat effectiveness.

items.name: Tropical Duck
items.description: It quietly dreams of taking to the skies with its brethren.
items.flavor_text: Can be thrown to create noise
items.article: The Tropical Duck is a trinket, similar to the Rubber Duck. You can throw it to create a noise, which can distract enemies. It can also be kept in your stash to decorate your Raider Den. This item is found inside chimneys when Bird City is active. Other duck variants include the Alien Duck, Doodly Duck, Familiar Duck, Flashy Duck, and Gentle Duck.

items.name: Turbine Compressor
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article:
The Turbine Compressor is a component used in crafting and specific game projects. It is combined with a Power Rod at a Utility Station to craft a Powered Descender, which is unlocked by the Powered Descender Blueprint. This item is also needed for an Expedition 4 project, alongside other items such as ARC Motion Core, Exodus Modules, and Speaker Component.

You can obtain Turbine Compressors by defeating Turbines. It is also dropped by Courier ARCs. Additionally, the Turbine Compressor can be recycled into salvage.

items.name: Turbo Pump
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Turbo Pump is a rare item that can be recycled to obtain crafting materials.

items.name: "Twilight Compass" Ship Model
items.description: A spirited up-and-comer, this two-master has been known to sail ever so slightly beyond the horizon.
items.article:
The "Twilight Compass" Ship Model is an Uncommon Trinket. You can place this ship model in your Raider Den to decorate it.

You can keep track of items needed for various projects using the Needed Items Tracker.

items.name: Unknown ARC Circuitry
items.description: A bundle of ARC circuitry, unfamiliar in both layout and design.

items.name: Unusable Weapon
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article:
The Unusable Weapon cannot be equipped or fired. Its main purpose is to be recycled for valuable crafting materials.

It is primarily found inside containers during raids. Most frequently found in the Spaceport map, it can also be found in the Blue Gate, Dam Battlegrounds, and Stella Montis maps. When recycled, it provides coins and other crafting materials.

items.name: Vaporizer Regulator
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article:
The Vaporizer Regulator is a component used for crafting and completing specific projects. At a Gunsmith crafting station, you can combine it with other items to craft a Dolabra, provided you have the Dolabra Blueprint. It is also needed for Stage 4 of the Expedition 4 project, joining other materials.

You acquire Vaporizer Regulators by defeating Vaporizers and Couriers. This item can also be recycled or salvaged for other materials.

items.name: Vase
items.description: Worth a small fortune.
items.article: The Vase is a rare trinket valued at 3,000 coins. Its main purpose is to be sold to earn coins. You can obtain this item by scavenging in Old World, Residential, and Commercial areas found within the map.

items.name: "Velocity" Ship Model
items.description: Optimized for performance, this marvel of technology sure hopes you weren't planning on packing a particularly elaborate lunch.
items.article:
The "Velocity" Ship Model is a trinket used to decorate your Hideout. You can place it in your stash for display.

Raiders can obtain this item by scavenging in the lower-level utility rooms of the apartments found within the Dam Battlegrounds map.

items.name: Venator Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Venator. Fires two shots at a time.
items.article: The Venator Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Venator at a crafting station.

items.name: Venator I
items.description: Fires two shots at a time.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Venator I is a semi-automatic pistol that fires two shots with each trigger pull, using one unit of medium ammo. This makes it effective for close to medium-range combat.

Raiders can find this item by scavenging or craft it once they have learned the Venator Blueprint, requiring Gunsmith. It can also be recycled or salvaged to obtain other materials.

items.name: Venator II
items.description: Fires two shots at a time.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Venator II is an upgraded version of the Venator I semi-automatic pistol. It fires two shots with each pull of the trigger while only using one unit of medium ammo, making it effective in close to medium-range fights. This specific version offers improved fire rate, faster reloading, and increased durability compared to its base model.

Raiders can obtain the Venator II by crafting it at the Gunsmith using a Venator I along with other crafting materials.

items.name: Venator III
items.description: Fires two shots at a time.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Venator III is an enhanced version of the Venator II pistol, designed for effective close to medium-range combat. It functions as a semi-automatic weapon that uniquely fires two projectiles with each trigger pull, yet only uses one unit of medium ammo per shot.

To obtain this weapon, craft it at a Gunsmith Bench level 1, commonly found in your Hideout. This process requires a Venator II along with other general crafting materials. As an upgrade, it comes with a 26% increased fire rate, 33% reduced reload time, and an additional 20 durability compared to its previous version.

items.name: Venator IV
items.description: Fires two shots at a time.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Venator IV is an advanced version of the Venator semi-automatic pistol, designed for effective close to medium-range combat. It fires two shots with each trigger pull while only consuming one unit of medium ammo. This pistol offers a significantly increased fire rate, a faster reload time, and improved durability compared to the base Venator I.

You obtain the Venator IV by upgrading a Venator III at a Gunsmith bench. The initial Venator I requires a learned Venator Blueprint to craft. It can also be recycled or salvaged to obtain resources.

items.name: Vertical Grip I
items.description: Slightly reduces vertical recoil.
items.article: The Vertical Grip I is a weapon modification used to improve weapon control. Attaching this grip to a compatible weapon helps to reduce the amount of upward movement (vertical recoil) when you fire, making it easier to keep your shots on target.

items.name: Vertical Grip II
items.description: Moderately reduces vertical recoil.

stat_block.compatibleWeapons: Rattler, Kettle, Ferro, Hullcracker, Venator

items.article:
The Vertical Grip II is a modification you can attach under your weapon. Its main job is to help you control your weapon better by reducing how much it kicks upwards when you fire.

Craft this item at a Gunsmith station using the Vertical Grip II Blueprint.

items.name: Vertical Grip II Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Vertical Grip II
items.article: The Vertical Grip II Blueprint is a blueprint used at the Gunsmith Bench level 1 that allows you to create the Vertical Grip II, an underbarrel weapon modification. Attaching this modification to a compatible weapon helps reduce its vertical recoil.

items.name: Vertical Grip III
items.description: Significantly reduces vertical recoil.
items.flavor_text: 30% Reduced ADS Speed
items.article:
Vertical Grip III is a weapon modification designed to significantly reduce a weapon's vertical recoil. Applying this grip will also make you aim down sights a little slower.

You can craft this item at the Gunsmith using the Vertical Grip III Blueprint.

items.name: Vertical Grip III Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Vertical Grip III
items.article:
The Vertical Grip III Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft the Vertical Grip III weapon mod at the Gunsmith. This mod greatly reduces a weapon's vertical recoil by 40%, helping you maintain accuracy during combat.

It can also be recycled for coins.

items.name: Very Comfortable Pillow
items.description: The envy of every Raider. Like sleeping on an especially ergonomic cloud.
items.article:
The Very Comfortable Pillow is a Trinket item.

It is used to improve workshop capabilities, specifically when upgrading the Scrappy workshop.

You can obtain this item by scavenging within Residential and Commercial areas on maps.

items.name: Vintage Steering Wheel
items.description: A harmonious artifact of three-way symmetry, some Nomads believe this to be an ancient reliquary honoring the lunar, the solar and the terrestrial.

items.name: Vita Shot
items.description: A medical item that restores a large amount of health.
items.article:
The Vita Shot is a medical item designed to restore a large amount of a Raider's health after a short delay, helping them recover quickly during engagements. You can sometimes find it while scavenging during your raids.

Alternatively, it can be crafted at Medical Lab once you have learned the Vita Shot Blueprint. If you have extra, it can be recycled into other resources.

items.name: Vita Shot Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Vita Shot - A medical item that restores a large amount of health.
items.article: The Vita Shot Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft vita shots at the Medical Lab. A vita shot is a medical item that restores a large amount of health when used. This blueprint has been observed to be found by Raiders in the Stella Montis map, particularly during medical night raids.

items.name: Vita Spray
items.description: A medical item that continuously restores health during use. Can be used on yourself or your allies.
items.flavor_text: Health Per Second: 10/s
items.article:
The Vita Spray is a medical item that continuously restores health. You can use it on yourself or your allies to regain health over time during raids.

You can find this item by scavenging in the environment. It can also be crafted at a Medical Lab once you have learned the Vita Spray Blueprint. It can be recycled for various resources.

items.name: Vita Spray Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Vita Spray
items.article: The Vita Spray Blueprint is a blueprint used at the Medical Lab to craft Vita Spray. This medical item continuously restores health when used, either on yourself or an ally.

items.name: Volcanic Rock
items.description: Can be thrown.
items.article: Volcanic Rock offers gameplay benefits. Raiders can use this resource to gain advantages during their raids.

items.name: Voltage Converter
items.description: Used in crafting.
items.article:
The Voltage Converter is a material used in crafting. You can use it at a gear bench to create certain gear, and at an explosives station to create certain explosives. It can also be recycled into other useful resources.

You can find this item by scavenging in the environment. It is also available for purchase from Celeste for 10 coins, with a daily limit of 5. Another way to get it is by recycling or salvaging other items.

items.name: Vulcano Blueprint
items.description: Allows you to craft the Vulcano.
items.article: The Vulcano Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft at the Refiner. You can find it by searching various containers during the Hidden Bunker map condition and by searching First Wave Caches during Hurricane map condition. Another rare blueprint you might find is the Tempest Blueprint.

items.name: Vulcano I
items.description: Has good bullet spread but sharp falloff.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article: The Vulcano I is a semi-automatic shotgun that uses shotgun ammo. This weapon is well-suited for close-range combat due to its wide bullet spread, though its effectiveness drops off quickly at longer distances. Raiders craft it at a Gunsmith, provided they have learned the Vulcano Blueprint. It serves as a base for crafting more advanced versions, such as the Vulcano II.

items.name: Vulcano II
items.description: Has good bullet spread but sharp falloff.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Vulcano II is a semi-automatic shotgun, representing an upgraded version of the Vulcano I. This weapon improves upon its predecessor by offering an increased fire rate, reduced reload time, and better durability for enhanced combat performance.

You can obtain this item by crafting it at the Gunsmith, upgrading a Vulcano I using various components. It can also be recycled to gain various resources.

items.name: Vulcano III
items.description: Has good bullet spread but sharp falloff.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Vulcano III is an upgraded semi-automatic shotgun designed for combat encounters. It improves upon earlier versions of the weapon by offering a higher fire rate, quicker reload time, and increased durability. This weapon uses shotgun ammo.

Raiders craft the Vulcano III at a Gunsmith by combining various components.

items.name: Vulcano IV
items.description: Has good bullet spread but sharp falloff.
items.flavor_text: Somewhat effective against ARC armor plating
items.article:
The Vulcano IV is the final version of the Vulcano semi-automatic shotgun line. It is a weapon designed for combat, utilizing ammunition. This particular version features improved performance attributes such as an increased fire rate, reduced reload time, and enhanced durability.

Raiders can craft the Vulcano IV at Gunsmith. This weapon can also be recycled to gain various resources.

items.name: Warden (Outfit)
items.description: This is the Warden cosmetic outfit
items.article: The Warden (Outfit) is a cosmetic item that changes the visual appearance of your character. It offers different color options to customize your character's look.

items.name: Wasp Driver
items.description: Can be recycled into ARC Alloy.
items.article:
The Wasp Driver is a throwable item that explodes if it is shot after being thrown, dealing damage to nearby ARCs and Raiders.

Raiders obtain this item by defeating Wasps, Wasp Husks, and Couriers.

This item is used in crafting projects and is needed for the The Trifecta quest. Additionally, it can be recycled for resources or salvaged for materials.

items.name: Water Filter
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article:
The Water Filter is a component that can be recycled into crafting materials, providing basic components for other items.

You can find this item by scavenging inside metal crates, commonly located in industrial areas:

  • Look in the west tunnels of the Research and Administration area, and also within the Power Generation Complex, both in the Dam Battlegrounds map.
  • Search the Shipping Warehouse in the Spaceport map.

items.name: Water Pump
items.description: Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article: The Water Pump is a rare item that Raiders can recycle for crafting materials and coins. It is also needed for the Unexpected Initiative quest. You can typically find this item inside industrial loot containers like Metal Crates, often located on carts or shelves. Specific areas to check include the Research and Administration west tunnels and Power Generation Complex in the Dam, and the Shipping Warehouse in the Spaceport.

items.name: White Flag
items.description: A deployable white flag.
items.article: The White Flag is a utility item that Raiders can set down or wave during their raids. It is crafted using the White Flag Blueprint at a Medical Lab. Once crafted, it can also be recycled into salvage.

items.name: White Flag Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a White Flag

guide_links.label: How to Find White Flag Blueprint

items.article: The White Flag Blueprint is a blueprint that allows you to craft a white flag.

items.name: White Indigo (Warden Color)
items.description: A new cosmetic variant will be added to your collection
items.article: The White Indigo (Warden Color) is a customization item used to change the appearance of the Warden outfit. Applying this color variant allows you to personalize the look of your character's gear.

items.name: "Wind Sprite" Ship Model
items.description: Undaunted in the face of its larger brethren, this nimble one-master has been known to brave even the most just-above-average of waves.
items.article:
The "Wind Sprite" Ship Model is a common trinket that can be used to decorate your Raider Den. Finding and extracting with this model also provides bonus Merits, which help you progress along the Miniature Voyages reward track during the Last Resort event.

You can obtain the "Wind Sprite" Ship Model by finding it as a loose item on furniture and inside residential containers. It commonly appears in the Hotel area on the Riven Tides map, and can also be found on other maps like the Buried City and Blue Gate.

items.name: Wires
items.description: Used to craft a wide range of items. Can be recycled into crafting materials.
items.article:
Wires are primarily used to craft various mod components. They are also needed to complete the After Rain Comes and Eyes On The Prize quests, as well as for the Expedition project.

You can find them by searching electrical and technological objects in the environment. They can also be obtained by recycling salvage or purchased from Celeste.

items.name: Wolfpack
items.description: A grenade that scatters into multiple homing missiles, each one targeting ARC and dealing explosive damage on impact.
items.article:
The Wolfpack is an explosive item that, when thrown, scatters into 12 homing missiles. These missiles automatically target nearby ARCs, exploding on impact to deal damage. It is particularly effective for dealing with larger ARCs and is considered a more powerful version of the Seeker Grenade.

Raiders craft this item at an Explosives Station after acquiring the Wolfpack Blueprint.

items.name: Wolfpack Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Wolfpack
items.article:
The Wolfpack Blueprint is a blueprint used at an Explosives Station to craft the Wolfpack grenade.

Once deployed, this grenade scatters into 12 individual homing missiles that quickly seek out and explode on impact with nearby ARCs. It is particularly effective for dealing significant damage to larger ARCs like the Rocketeer, Bastion, Bombardier, and Leaper.

items.name: Yank Grenade
items.description: A grenade that anchors a line to whatever it hits, pulling the target toward the point of impact.

items.name: Yank Grenade Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Yank Grenade

items.name: Yellow Light Stick
items.description: A throwable chemical light that illuminates the area around it.
items.flavor_text: Illumination Radius 7m
items.article: The Yellow Light Stick is a specific type of light stick. It is one of several variations, alongside the Green Light Stick and Blue Light Stick.

items.name: Yellow Light Stick Blueprint
items.description: Lets you craft a Yellow Light Stick
items.article: The Yellow Light Stick Blueprint is a blueprint used at a crafting station to craft yellow light sticks.

items.name: Yellow (Radio Renegade Color)
items.description: A new cosmetic variant will be added to your collection.
items.article: The Yellow (Radio Renegade Color) is a cosmetic option that lets you change the appearance of your radio. This color allows Raiders to personalize it to a yellow shade.

items.name: Zipline
items.description: A deployable zipline that allows you to quickly move between two locations.
items.article:
The Zipline is a utility item that helps you travel quickly between two spots. You can attach it to most surfaces to create a fast path between locations, making travel more efficient.

You can craft this item at a Utility Station. It can also be purchased from Apollo for coins, with a daily limit of three. Additionally, you can find ziplines within Raider Deck AR/RD 001 and Raider Deck AR/RD 002. When no longer needed, it can be recycled for basic resources.

quests.name: A Bad Feeling
objectives: Find and search any ARC Probe or ARC Courier
quests.description:
Even the slightest change to ARC's behavior could spell disaster.

And that signal you heard? It's like nothing we've ever picked up. If they're up to something, we need to find out whatever we can.

objective_graph.description: Find and search any ARC Probe or ARC Courier

quests.name: A Balanced Harvest
objectives: Go to the Research & Administration building
Locate Lab 1 on the upper floor above the reception
Search for any traces of the agricultural research project
quests.description: Our food production is finally enough to meet our basic needs, but what we really need now is variety. I have a lead on some agricultural research from before the First Wave. Are you in?

objective_graph.description: Go to the Research & Administration building
Locate Lab 1 on the upper floor above the reception
Search for any traces of the agricultural research project

quests.name: A Better Use
objectives: Request in a Supply Drop from a Call Station
Loot a Supply Drop
quests.description: We're short on everything but mouths to feed, yet Celeste's launching precious supplies into the air for Raiders to claw over. I’m done letting the good stuff go to waste.

objective_graph.description: Request in a Supply Drop from a Call Station
Loot a Supply Drop

quests.name: A Dead End
objectives: Find MANTIKOR's underground facilities
Find a way into into the locked room in the Security Wing
Search the locked room for any records on Project Heartwood
Find the Dusty Film Reel
Deliver the Dusty Film Reel to Shani
quests.description:
I… I don’t get it. One day they were trying to stave off the Collapse, and then, suddenly… Nothing.

That earthquake-resistant housing project was shut down by a group named MANTIKOR. Think you could find out more?

objective_graph.description: Find MANTIKOR's underground facilities
Find a way into into the locked room in the Security Wing
Search the locked room for any records on Project Heartwood
Find the Dusty Film Reel
Deliver the Dusty Film Reel to Shani

quests.name: A First Foothold
objectives: Stabilize the observation deck near the Ridgeline
Enable the comms terminal near the Olive Grove
Rotate the satellite dishes on the church roof, north of the Data Vault
Nail down the roof plates on the Raider structure near Trapper's Glade
quests.description:
We’ve only just finished expanding the Tube network towards the Blue Gate, and we’re still laboring away at the rest.

My crew’s been building new infrastructure around the valley to safeguard our Raiders, but the constant ARC threat has made it difficult to get anything done.

objective_graph.description: Stabilize the observation deck near the Ridgeline
Enable the comms terminal near the Olive Grove
Rotate the satellite dishes on the church roof, north of the Data Vault
Nail down the roof plates on the Raider structure near Trapper's Glade

quests.name: A Lay of the Land
objectives: Reach the Jiangsu Warehouse
Find the shipping notes in the foreman’s office
Locate the scanners in the Flight Control office of Control Tower A6
Deliver 1 LiDAR Scanners to Shani
quests.description:
Those distant rumbles are getting less distant with each passing day.

I have a lead on some LiDAR scanners that may help us monitor the tremors. You do want to keep a roof over your head, don’t you?

objective_graph.description: Reach the Jiangsu Warehouse
Find the shipping notes in the foreman’s office
Locate the scanners in the Flight Control office of Control Tower A6
Deliver 1 LiDAR Scanners to Shani

quests.name: A New Type of Plant
objectives: Search for the new plant near the Baron Husk in the Old Battleground
Deliver the Possibly Toxic Plant to Lance
quests.description: Some scouts have been bringing back reports of these weird plants spreading into the area. Now, this makes your old pal Lance think it may have some interesting uses.

objective_graph.description: Search for the new plant near the Baron Husk in the Old Battleground
Deliver the Possibly Toxic Plant to Lance

quests.name: A Path Not Yours
objectives: Find the start of the Nomad trail under the Highway Collapse
Follow the trail markers to the Nomad hideout
Find Bilguun's gift at the buried cache under the hideout
Loot the secret stash in Bilguun's hideout
Deliver the Broken Compass to the Nomadic Envoy
quests.description: Before our paths changed, we lingered by the Blue Gate for some time. We believe there is an old trail from those days, and something belonging to us may still lie at its end.

objective_graph.description: Loot the secret stash in Bilguun's hideout
Find the start of the Nomad trail under the Highway Collapse
Follow the trail markers to the Nomad hideout
Find Bilguun's gift at the buried cache under the hideout
Deliver the Broken Compass to the Nomadic Envoy

quests.name: A Prime Specimen
objectives: Obtain 2 ARC Powercells
Interact with any ARC Deforester
Loot an ARC Deforester
quests.description: That Deforester by the Blue Gate may have caused some real devastation, but a pristine husk like that is also an invaluable sample for our research.

objective_graph.description: Obtain 2 ARC Powercells
Interact with any ARC Deforester
Loot an ARC Deforester

quests.name: A Reveal in Ruins
objectives: Search for an ESR Analyzer inside any pharmacy in Buried City
Deliver the ESR Analyzer to Lance
quests.description: I got my hands on a fancy new ESR analyzer; had a whole big reveal planned. One minute it’s here, next minute—poof. Please help?

objective_graph.description: Search for an ESR Analyzer inside any pharmacy in Buried City
Deliver the ESR Analyzer to Lance

quests.name: A Rising Tide
objectives: On Buried City, find the foreman's barricaded apartment south of Piazza Roma
Access the foreman's digital logbook
On Dam Battlegrounds, reach the Power Generation Complex
Find a way into the Controlled Access Zone
Search the Controlled Access Zone for any clues about the foreman's reconstruction project
quests.description: Says here there was a foreman at The Dam, who got recruited right after they canceled Project Heartwood. Got put in charge of some big reconstruction project.

objective_graph.description: On Buried City, find the foreman's barricaded apartment south of Piazza Roma
Access the foreman's digital logbook
On Dam Battlegrounds, reach the Power Generation Complex
Find a way into the Controlled Access Zone
Search the Controlled Access Zone for any clues about the foreman's reconstruction project

quests.name: A Symbol of Unification
objectives: Reach the Formicai Outpost in Dam Battlegrounds
Locate the flag at the Formicai Outpost
Hoist the flag on the small platform overlooking the Red Lake
quests.description: Y’know, back in the day we actually used to have a flag - well, a scrap of cloth more than anything. Still, seeing it meant you knew you had allies nearby, that you were on your own home turf. So, I was thinking…

objective_graph.description: Reach the Formicai Outpost in Dam Battlegrounds
Locate the flag at the Formicai Outpost
Hoist the flag on the small platform overlooking the Red Lake

quests.name: A Toxic Trail
objectives: Return to the water intake below the Water Treatment Control building
Search the swamp for traces of the barrel's origins
Transmit the location of the barrel truck
Search the truck for clues about the saboteur's identity
quests.description: We've got clean water again, but we can't risk people falling ill if the saboteurs return. We need to root them out once and for all.

objective_graph.description: Return to the water intake below the Water Treatment Control building
Search the swamp for traces of the barrel's origins
Transmit the location of the barrel truck
Search the truck for clues about the saboteur's identity

quests.name: A Warm Place To Rest
objectives: Locate the Abandoned Highway Camp
Search for any signs of survivors
Follow the red markers
Inspect the grave
quests.description: A customer of mine saw a family taking cover in an old encampment in Buried City. I'll pay anyone who manages to find them and escort them back to safety.

objective_graph.description: Locate the Abandoned Highway Camp
Search for any signs of survivors
Follow the red markers
Inspect the grave

quests.name: A Wrench in the Works
objectives: Search the buses near the western gate
Locate the stash of sabotage supplies hidden at the Water Towers
quests.description: Looks like the resentment ended up reaching the ground staff of the Spaceport itself. A mutiny brewing, right in the heart of the Exodus.

objective_graph.description: Search the buses near the western gate
Locate the stash of sabotage supplies hidden at the Water Towers

quests.name: After Rain Comes
objectives: Find the flooded solar panels nearby the Grandioso Apartments
Repair the solar panels using 5 Wires and 2 Batteries
quests.description:
I know, I know! The power's down in sector—
Oh, hey. A flash flood took out some of our solar panels in Buried City, and the generators only hold on for so long.

Do us all a solid when you're up there, OK?

objective_graph.description: Find the flooded solar panels nearby the Grandioso Apartments
Repair the solar panels using 5 Wires and 2 Batteries

quests.name: Armored Transports
objectives: Reach the Checkpoint
Search the Guard huts for an Armored Patrol Key Card
Reach the Traffic Tunnel near the Blue Gate Checkpoint
Find a spare Armored Patrol Car Key Card
Find and unlock the rear door of an armored patrol car
quests.description:
Ever since we expanded the tunnels to the Blue Gate, some rare pieces have started appearing on the black market.

Meanwhile, I'm stuck here peddling battered old Rattlers. If I don't find new supply lines, I'll be left in the dust.

objective_graph.description: Reach the Checkpoint
Search the Guard huts for an Armored Patrol Key Card
Reach the Traffic Tunnel near the Blue Gate Checkpoint
Find a spare Armored Patrol Car Key Card
Find and unlock the rear door of an armored patrol car

quests.name: Back on Top
objectives: On Dam Battlegrounds, mark the Pattern House
On The Blue Gate, mark the white lookout tower south of the Warehouse Complex
On Spaceport, mark the South Trench Tower
On Buried City, mark the building with the mural in the Buried Properties
quests.description: Guess what? Shani asked me to help out with something, and for once, I’m actually glad she did. We’re setting up new outposts topside! Or, planning to, at least. Can you believe it?

objective_graph.description: On Dam Battlegrounds, mark the Pattern House
On The Blue Gate, mark the white lookout tower south of the Warehouse Complex
On Spaceport, mark the South Trench Tower
On Buried City, mark the building with the mural in the Buried Properties

quests.name: Bait, Fetch, Blast
objectives: Destroy a Bully
Destroy the head of a Bully
Destroy 4 Bully legs
Deliver a Bully Fragmenter to Apollo
quests.description: Tough nuts to crack, those Bullies. But you know, nothing’s indestructible. I’ve heard of a few tricks that might just work, care to put them to a test?

objective_graph.description: Destroy a Bully
Destroy the head of a Bully
Deliver a Bully Fragmenter to Apollo
Destroy 4 Bully legs

quests.name: Battening Down
objectives: Photograph the cracks forming in the seawall
Sample the shoreline near the hotel beach
Fix the leaking oil pipe in the northeast
quests.description: We’d hoped the seawalls at Riven Tides might offer us some protection from the elements, but it seems the hurricanes were not kind to this place, either.

objective_graph.description: Photograph the cracks forming in the seawall
Sample the shoreline near the hotel beach
Fix the leaking oil pipe in the northeast

quests.name: Bees!
objectives: Reach the Olive Grove in Blue Gate
Search for bee hives around the Olive Grove
quests.description: Bees! There are bees still around! While I’m no expert, our greenhouse crew desperately wants some.

objective_graph.description: Reach the Olive Grove in Blue Gate
Search for bee hives around the Olive Grove

quests.name: Belly of the Beast
objectives: Acquire an Emperor Gateway Conduit
Enter the Emperor
Find where the power inside the Emperor comes from
Find out what happens to the Harvester Payloads that enter the Emperor
Find where the Harvester Payloads sent to the Emperor are stored
Search 5 containers inside the Emperor
Obtain a unique piece of Emperor loot
quests.description: ARC’s been swarming that fallen Emperor like flies on honey. I’m picking up signals from far beyond the Rust Belt, and they’re not slowing down.

objective_graph.description: Acquire an Emperor Gateway Conduit
Enter the Emperor
Find where the power inside the Emperor comes from
Find where the Harvester Payloads sent to the Emperor are stored
Search 5 containers inside the Emperor
Find out what happens to the Harvester Payloads that enter the Emperor
Obtain a unique piece of Emperor loot

quests.name: Boarding the Frigate
objectives: Find a way on top of the Frigate
Damage a Hydra
Damage a Vaporizer
Damage a Rocketeer
quests.description:
None of our old tactics work, facing those Frigates. We can’t run. We can’t hide. And there’s no waiting them out.

We need to take bold action, and we need to do it now.

objective_graph.description: Find a way on top of the Frigate
Establish a foothold on top of the Frigate
Damage a Hydra
Damage a Vaporizer
Damage a Rocketeer

quests.name: Bombing Run
objectives: Destroy a Bombardier
Deliver a Bombardier Cell to Shani
quests.description: Now, time to see if that recon paid off. If we can teach Raiders to effectively counter Bombardiers up there, we’d be a lot safer down here.

objective_graph.description: Destroy a Bombardier
Deliver a Bombardier Cell to Shani

quests.name: Broken Monument
objectives: Reach the hallowed grounds by the Scrap Yard
Search for a compass near the broken-down vehicles
Deliver First Wave Compass to Tian Wen
Search for the video tape near the cylindrical containers
Deliver the First Wave Tape to Tian Wen
Search for the old field rations in the Raider camp
